The role

At Black Sun, we believe great creative work starts by finding what matters.

As a Designer, you will help turn ideas, stories and complex information into clear, engaging and beautifully crafted communications for some of the world’s leading businesses.

You will work alongside designers, Creative Directors, account teams and other specialists, contributing to projects from early creative exploration through to final delivery.

This is a role for someone with strong design foundations who wants to keep developing. You should be as interested in why something is being designed as how it looks. We want you to ask questions, contribute ideas, explore different solutions and become increasingly confident in your own creative judgement.

You will have support and direction from more experienced members of the team, but we will also expect you to take ownership of your work and grow your contribution over time.

What you will do

Find what matters

Understand the brief before you begin designing.

* Take time to understand the client, audience, content and purpose of the work.
* Ask questions when something is unclear and start to recognise what information matters most.
* Look beyond what you have been given and bring useful references, observations and inspiration into the creative process.

Have an idea

Contribute to creative exploration rather than simply waiting for a design direction.

* Develop and share ideas, sketches and visual approaches.
* Explore different ways to solve a problem rather than settling immediately on the most obvious answer.
* Understand the idea behind the work and help maintain it as the project develops.

Make complexity clear

Turn content, data and information into communication that is easy to understand and navigate.

* Use typography, hierarchy, layout, imagery and information design to help tell the story.
* Create charts, diagrams and other visualisations that make information clearer rather than simply more decorative.
* Develop your ability to recognise what should lead, what should support and what can be simplified.

Make every choice for a reason

Create thoughtful, well crafted design across print and digital projects.

* Apply strong design fundamentals including typography, composition, colour, imagery and layout.
* Work confidently within established brand and design systems while recognising opportunities to explore and develop them.
* Prepare accurate, well organised files and work closely with publishing and production colleagues through to delivery.
* Respond positively to creative direction and feedback, understanding why changes are being made rather than simply making them.
* Build confidence with new tools and creative possibilities, including motion, digital, AI and emerging technologies where they can strengthen the work.

Make a difference

Take pride in the quality of everything you produce.

* Be curious about whether the work is communicating effectively, not simply whether it looks good.
* Share your thinking in creative reviews and be prepared to explain the choices you have made.
* Learn from the people around you and contribute your own perspective in return.
* Look for ways to make the work stronger, clearer and more engaging.

What we are looking for

You are a designer with around two to three years' professional experience and a portfolio that demonstrates strong foundations, good ideas and an eye for detail.

We are looking for someone who is curious, ambitious about their work and wants to become a better designer.

You will bring:

* Strong graphic design and typographic foundations
* Good visual thinking and an interest in ideas
* Confidence using Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop
* An understanding of hierarchy, layout, imagery and composition
* An interest in information design and data visualisation
* Experience preparing accurate design work for print and digital use
* Good attention to detail
* The ability to organise your workload and meet deadlines
* Confidence communicating and collaborating with colleagues
* Openness to creative direction, challenge and feedback
* Curiosity about new tools, technologies and creative disciplines
* A willingness to learn, experiment and keep improving
* Experience in corporate communications, reporting or sustainability is useful, but it is not essential. We are more interested in how you think, the quality of your work and your potential to grow.

How you will work

You will collaborate closely with:

* Creative Directors and Design Directors
* Senior, midweight and junior designers
* Account Managers and wider account teams
* Publishing and production teams
* Strategy and content specialists
* Digital and other creative specialists

You will be encouraged to participate in the creative process, share your thinking and learn from people with different skills and experience.

What success looks like

You will be making a strong contribution when:

* Your work demonstrates good thinking as well as good craft
* You understand the purpose behind what you are designing
* You contribute ideas rather than simply execute instructions
* You can take increasing ownership of defined pieces of work
* Your design choices are considered and you can explain why you made them
* You respond well to feedback and your work improves because of it
* Colleagues trust you to deliver accurate, thoughtful work when you say you will
* You are developing your skills, confidence and creative judgement
* You make a positive contribution to the team

Our creative belief

Black Sun exists to illuminate potential.

We believe creativity helps reveal what others cannot yet see. The insight beneath the information. The opportunity beneath the complexity. The story beneath the strategy.

That shapes how we work:

* Find what matters.
* Have an idea.
* Make complexity clear.
* Make every choice for a reason.
* Make a difference.

**Our employer promise is built around three pillars:**

• Being a great place to work

• Committed to sustainability and having a positive impact

• Being dedicated to the development of our people

The EQD&CE UK Legal team is part of the Derivatives platform in Legal, primarily advising the Equity Derivatives and Cash Equity business lines within the Global Equities Global Business Line of BNPP Global Markets (“GM”). The Derivatives Platform is an organisation within Legal comprising legal professionals providing legal advice and transactional support to GM more broadly as well as other Legal teams, Functions and various stakeholders in BNP Paribas.

The Quantitative Investment Strategies (“**QIS**”) business is a fast-paced and high-profile area of the Global Markets division. QIS is responsible for the development, creation and maintenance of BNP Paribas proprietary indices across all asset classes traded within GM. BNP Paribas proprietary indices employ a wide range of innovative methodologies, including active management, convexity, dispersion, multi asset efficient frontiers, option/swaption writing, rolling futures and stock selection including based on themes such as clean energy, climate care and other ESG topics.

**JOB PURPOSE**

**Purpose:**The EQD&CE Legal Executive supports other more senior members of the EQD&CE team in providing specialist legal and/or regulatory advice to the QIS business to ensure that the QIS business is effectively supported, and able to achieve its objectives, whilst effectively identifying and managing legal risk.

**Scope:** **EMEA**and/or other jurisdictional advice provided ad hoc as needed

The EQD&CE Legal Executive will be involved in projects, develop relationships with stakeholders and undertake tasks focused on QIS coverage in order to assist more senior members of the team in providing high quality, timely, legal advice to the QIS business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide legal, regulatory and documentation support under the supervision of more senior lawyers within EQD&CE in relation to the range of BNP Paribas Indices administered by QIS, including in relation to tasks such as:
  + reviewing index methodology supplements (“**IMS**s”), which are comprised of narrative and formulaic descriptions of the calculation and rebalancing algorithm used to determine an index and ancillary documents such as Technical Annexes;
  + liaising with structurers and/or clients to negotiate comments on IMSs;
  + preparing comments for internal approval committee meetings in respect of:
    - new indices
    - events impacting the composition of an index requiring action by the committee;
    - errors occurring in the determination process
  + attending the relevant committee meetings to determine the course of action to take, including any remediations to internal processes that may be needed;
  + assisting senior members of the team with updates to master documentation and templates when necessary; and
  + for actively managed indices, negotiating contracts with the relevant third party providing index compositions and weightings.

* Assist more senior members of the team in identifying potential process improvements to ensure efficiency and effectiveness of the support provided
* Build internal working relationships with colleagues in EQD&CE to increase knowledge of relevant activities and with the wider LEGAL department

* Non-qualified lawyer, paralegal, finance/mathematics professional, or recent graduate in law, mathematics or finance, showing an interest in and willingness to learn more about matters relating to QIS such as the algorithms and formulae used to calculate and rebalance indices, products in which indices are used, how these products are hedged and the implications when structuring an index
* A university degree within a relevant subject as an indicator of an ability to understand and apply complex mathematical, trading and/or theoretical concepts, or equivalent relevant experience
* Basic knowledge of derivatives considered helpful; interest in and willingness to learn about different types of derivatives and the behaviour of the various asset classes used essential.
* A strong personal focus on accuracy and attention to detail
* Ability to prioritise and deliver workload based on shifting business needs under supervision and with guidance

* Capable of working both autonomously (with senior support as required) as well as part of a cross-disciplinary team.

* Interested in developing knowledge of the Bank, the industry, and its products / services

And of course, we expect all our colleagues to embody and practice the Group values (alignment with the Bank’s strategy, commitment, work ethic, integrity and Code of Conduct).

**A bit more about why you should join us**

**1. We’re a great place to work**

We aim for optimal work/life balance (depending on role, this includes hybrid working, flexible working and agile)

We are proud of our award-winning flexible benefits and health & wellbeing strategy. Our flexible benefits include:

* Generous holiday allowance of at least 26 days (plus bank holidays) – with option to buy and sell holidays.

But impact for us means more than climate. It means empowering our people every day. Everyone gets four volunteering days each year – in 2023, we achieved over 18,000 hours of volunteering across the UK and reaching over 4,500 young people.

3+ months rolling contract

**About the role**

We are seeking a CyberArk Architect to lead solution design for a large-scale, TSA-regulated Privileged Access Management (PAM) migration and merger consolidation programme. This is a hands-on architecture role spanning vault migration design, identity federation, and application onboarding strategy for an estate spanning thousands of accounts and 250+ dependent applications, delivered against a fixed regulatory deadline.

**Key responsibilities**

**Migration & vault architecture**

* Design the end-to-end migration architecture from CyberArk v12.2 to v14.2, covering entity extraction (REST API primary, PACLI fallback), transformation, reconciliation, and staged loading into the target vault.
* Define the staged-ingestion model: disabled import → CPM soft-verification → dual-run mirroring → forced rotation at cutover — ensuring no credential is exposed to a script or human during migration.
* Own name-collision resolution, platform normalisation, and policy reconciliation rules between source and target environments.
* Produce migration runbooks, RAID logs, and effort-sizing models across Safes, Accounts, Platforms, and Policies.

**Application & credential provider (CP/CCP) strategy**

* Lead discovery to segment the 250+ dependent applications by integration pattern (CP agent, CCP centralised, Conjur, direct SSO) — the primary driver of onboarding sequencing and timeline risk.
* Design the CP/CCP re-onboarding approach, including AppID re-provisioning, certificate/mTLS re-issuance, and phased cutover waves.
* Define rollback and dual-run strategy per wave, including the read-only fallback window on the source vault.

**Identity federation & MFA**

* Design PVWA federation to Entra ID via SAML/OIDC, including claims mapping from Entra groups to CyberArk Vault Users and Safe membership.
* Architect the RSA SecurID → Entra MFA migration as a re-enrolment exercise, covering Conditional Access policy design and non-web/legacy client bridging (PrivateArk, PACLI, RADIUS-dependent flows).
* Ensure High Side / Low Side segregation is preserved across all federation and migration data flows, with no entitlement detail crossing the DMZ boundary.

**Governance, compliance & stakeholder leadership**

* Own architecture decisions and trade-offs; present designs to client security, compliance, and PAM leadership for sign-off.
* Ensure all migration and access-control designs produce audit evidence sufficient for TSA compliance reporting.
* Evaluate and position complementary tooling (e.g. Hydden for continuous identity discovery) against native CyberArk capability.
* Define acceptance criteria and go/no-go gates for pilot and production wave sign-off.
* Mentor and provide technical direction to CyberArk Senior Engineers delivering the build.

**Required experience & skills**

* **10+ years** in Identity and Access Management, with **5+ years** specifically in CyberArk PAM architecture and design.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of CyberArk EPV, PVWA, CPM, PSM, AAM/CCP, and Vault architecture across on-prem and Privilege Cloud deployments.
* Proven experience leading a CyberArk version migration (v10/v11/v12 → v13/v14) at enterprise scale.
* Strong working knowledge of SAML 2.0 and OIDC federation design, including experience integrating CyberArk PVWA with an enterprise IdP (Entra ID, Okta, or equivalent).
* Experience with credential provider architectures (CP, CCP) and application onboarding at scale (100+ application estates).
* Familiarity with MFA migration projects (e.g. RSA SecurID to a cloud MFA/Conditional Access model).
* Experience operating in regulated environments (financial services, telecom, or government) with formal change control and audit evidence requirements.
* Strong client-facing communication skills; able to present architecture to both technical and executive stakeholders.

### Information Security Responsibilities

* Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets

# Technical Product Marketing Manager (previous developer) - EMEA

GB, London (Hybrid)

#### **Description**

We are looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager (with previous hands-on development experience) to take our developer-facing products to market. You will own positioning, messaging and go-to-market for these products, and orchestrate programs, motions, and campaigns across multiple channels to drive meaningful growth. Your work will directly influence revenue KPIs as well as product roadmap and priorities.

This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable reading documentation, running an API call, and testing the products you market from the user’s perspective.

#### **Responsibilities**

* **Positioning & Messaging:** Own the strategic positioning and messaging for your products. Keep it differentiated and technically accurate, and ensure consistency across all channels to improve conversion and pipeline quality.
* **Go-to-Market Leadership:** Own go-to-market and launch strategy, planning, and execution - including commercial decisions on pricing, packaging, and promotions - aligning teams across the company to drive pipeline and revenue.
* **Market Intelligence:** Own the market, customer, and competitive intelligence for your domain - continuously gather and synthesize insights to guide GTM strategy and inform roadmap, pricing, and positioning decisions.
* **Agentic Growth:** Contribute to our strategy and execution for discoverability and selection by AI agents - documentation, content, and integrations that make our products the default choice for agents and the developers who use them.
* **Sales Enablement:** Own sales enablement for your products - arm customer-facing teams with the tools, content, and knowledge needed to confidently and effectively sell and support them.
* **Copywriting:** Write and own the copy for all related marketing and GTM initiatives - product pages, launch content, technical comparisons, and enablement materials.
* **Cross-Functional Contribution: Contribute** to channel and campaign strategy, brand narrative and thought-leadership themes, and partner and ecosystem programs.

#### **Requirements**

* 3+ years in product marketing or technical marketing, ideally for API-first, data, infrastructure, or developer tools products.
* Proven experience taking technical products to market and running cross-functional programs involving Product, Sales, Growth, and DevRel teams.
* Technical fluency: you understand how software gets built - the development lifecycle, how developers evaluate and adopt tools, AI ecosystem and the role of coding agents and modern coding environments in day-to-day development work.
* Strong writing skills in English - clear, concise, and precise, for both technical and business audiences.
* Analytical mindset: comfortable with funnel metrics, adoption data, and win/loss analysis

Big plus

* Hands-on development experience - a current or former developer is a strong advantage
* Background in AI/ML data ecosystems (training data, RAG, agents, MCP)
* Experience with both self-serve (PLG) and enterprise sales motions

# Graduate AI and Secure Technologies Engineer (2026 start)

**Cambridge, UK**  
**UK travel and occasional international travel**

### **Introduction**

We’re looking for graduates who are excited by the opportunity to make emerging technologies secure, trustworthy and resilient. You’ll work on real-world engineering challenges across cyber security, artificial intelligence, embedded systems and connected technologies, supporting projects in areas including defence and security, industrial systems and critical national infrastructure.

You’ll need to be curious, willing to learn and comfortable exploring unfamiliar technical problems. In return, we’ll provide the support, mentoring and hands-on experience you need to develop into a confident, well-rounded security engineer working on innovative deep technology.

We’re much more interested in the engineer you can become than the one you are now. We’ll give you the time, support and opportunities to build your security engineering skills and develop the confidence to contribute to challenging client projects. Curiosity, a careful and structured approach to problem solving, and enthusiasm for technology are more important than having experience in every area of cyber security.

## 

### **Overview**

Cambridge Consultants develops deep technology across sensing, communications, embedded systems, artificial intelligence and complex systems. Our Trusted AI and Secure Technologies team helps clients understand, design and demonstrate security and trustworthiness in emerging and connected technologies.

You’ll work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside engineers and specialists in electronics, firmware, software, RF, AI and data science, and systems engineering. Projects can span the full engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concepts and requirements through to implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

Our work includes cyber security, secure-by-design engineering, embedded and connected systems, industrial and critical infrastructure, defence and national security, edge AI, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

### **Your responsibilities**

You’ll work on real client assignments with support and guidance from experienced engineers. You’ll have opportunities to contribute across different stages of the engineering lifecycle and work alongside specialists from across Cambridge Consultants.

You may contribute to projects at different stages of the engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concept development and requirements through to architecture, implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

You’ll also have opportunities to interact directly with clients, including requirements discussions, technical workshops, progress updates and delivery, with support from experienced engineers where appropriate.

### **What you’ll be doing**

* Contributing to threat modelling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments.
* Helping to identify security requirements and develop secure-by-design system architectures.
* Supporting vulnerability assessments and security testing, including helping to scope testing activities and track remediation.
* Investigating vulnerabilities and helping teams understand and address security risks.
* Contributing to security cases, assurance activities and technical documentation.
* Analysing systems, software and technical designs to identify potential security weaknesses.
* Developing prototypes, analysis tools or other technical solutions to investigate security problems.
* Working with multidisciplinary teams to understand the interaction between security, functionality, safety and system performance.
* Communicating technical findings clearly to engineers, project teams and customers.

**Domains and project types**

You could work across a range of applications and technologies, including:

* **Critical national infrastructure:** energy, transport, communications and utilities.
* **Industrial systems:** ICS, SCADA, OT and industrial IoT.
* **Defence and national security:** secure systems and technologies supporting demanding operational environments.
* **Emerging technologies:** AI assurance, sensing, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

### **What you can bring**

**The below is essential**

* An excellent degree or PhD in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.
* 12 months industrial experience, for example through a placement year or relevant postgraduate experience.
* A good understanding of fundamental engineering, computing or security principles.
* Practical experience through university, industrial placement, work experience, research or personal projects in at least one or more relevant areas, such as:

* + cyber/security engineering
  + software or application development
  + embedded systems
  + computer or network systems
  + electronics or hardware security
  + AI or data science
  + systems engineering

* The ability to understand and analyse technical systems and identify risks or weaknesses.
* Some familiarity with security concepts such as authentication, authorisation, cryptography, key management, secure boot, network security and secure development.
* The ability to read and understand code in languages such as C, C++, Python or Java.
* Enthusiasm for learning and developing new technical skills.
* A careful and structured approach to problem solving.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.

**The below is advantageous, but isn’t essential**

* Familiarity with threat-modelling approaches such as STRIDE or MITRE ATT&CK.
* Knowledge of secure development practices and frameworks such as OWASP or CWE.
* Experience with embedded platforms, MCUs, RTOS, TPMs or TrustZone.
* Familiarity with industrial protocols and standards such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA or IEC 62443.
* Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Wireshark or firmware-analysis tools.
* An understanding of cloud security.
* Experience considering security alongside safety or other system-level requirements.
* Security research, university projects, technical projects or open-source contributions.
* Industry certifications or formal security training.

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check level security clearance ( https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.

Along with your CV, please describe why you are attracted to this position, what you feel you offer Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of. We are especially interested to hear about any projects you have done, for a hobby, for work or for university.

As a Senior Scientist in **Bioscience**, you will play a key role in defining and supporting critical path drug discovery biology for both small and large molecule therapeutics.

The successful candidate will join our Discovery Biology team within our Bioscience department and apply their extensive technical expertise and knowledge to biomarker discovery, evaluating biological and disease mechanisms of action, as well as experimentally interrogating clinical positioning hypotheses.

This is therefore a laboratory focused role that requires a deep scientific understanding of cancer biology, strong laboratory technical skills, and hands-on experience of drug discovery.   + ELISA/MSD immunoassays

  + Mechanisms of drug action and drug resistance.
  + Pharmacology concepts.
* Strong experimental design, technical expertise, and scientific problem-solving skills.
* Proven track record developing and applying PD biomarkers, mechanism of action, or clinical positioning studies to support delivery of drug discovery programmes.

**What will I gain?**

We create a working environment that supports your wellbeing and provide a generous benefits package, a wide range of career and personal development opportunities and high-quality tools. Our policies and processes enable you to improve your work-life balance, take positive steps in your career and achieve your personal wellbeing goals.

Cardiff

**We’re Capital on Tap 👋**💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

📍 [Cardiff] | 🏢 [3 days in the office per week]

**Financial Crime/Customer Operations 🚀**Our Financial Crime team is growing quickly along with the company. They work on the front line to protect the company against financial crime such as money laundering and terrorist financing. From screening, onboarding, transaction monitoring through to CDD and EDD, they make decisions that really matter on a daily basis.

**The Role 🚀**

We're looking for a Financial Crime and Disputes Agent to join our first-line team protecting UK and US customers from fraud, financial crime, and payment disputes. This is a hands-on, case-handling role covering both disciplines, from financial crime alerts and due diligence reviews through to disputes and chargebacks, making sure customers get fast and fair outcomes, day in and day out.

**This role works a 5-day week, this will include every weekend and every bank holiday Monday, with your rest days falling elsewhere in the week.**

**What You’ll Be Doing 🗃️**

* Investigating and processing financial crime cases - including due diligence reviews, KYC refreshes, and financial crime alerts and referrals - in line with policy, procedure, and regulatory requirements.
* Investigating and resolving fraud cases, including unauthorised transactions and chargebacks, in line with card scheme rules and regulatory timelines.
* Identifying and appropriately supporting vulnerable customers and victims of fraud throughout their case.
* Keep your knowledge fresh, you’ll be staying up to date with fraud typologies, financial crime risks, and relevant regulation.
* Working collaboratively with the wider Fraud, Financial Crime, Disputes, and Compliance teams to share knowledge, flag emerging risks, and support continuous improvement.

* **Just Pilot:** We never settle for “good enough”. We pilot new ideas fast, ask questions to figure it out, and scale quickly.

* **Be a Buddy:** We tap in from day one to help the team, we do the right thing even if it’s hard.
* **Owners and Dates:** We don’t chase people. If you own a task and agree to a date, the expectation is that it gets done.
* **Feedback:** We want our employees to flourish, so we regularly provide direct and constructive feedback.

**We’re Looking For 🔎**

* Experience in a fraud, financial crime, or disputes role within financial services.
* Strong attention to detail and sound, evidence-based judgement when making case-level decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-first mindset.
* Comfortable working to targets and SLAs in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
* A genuine commitment to delivering good customer outcomes..

### **Our culture**

Centerprise offers a professional, collaborative environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, develop their capabilities and take pride in delivering for customers. We value open communication, personal responsibility and constructive challenge.

### **Apply now**

If you are a commercially driven sales professional who enjoys building new customer relationships and wants to develop a career in the technology sector, apply to join the Ci North team.

**About the role:**

Lead a live voice AI recruitment venture inside a Series C health-tech scaleup. The product calls every applicant within five minutes, screens them against the hirer’s criteria, and books the qualified ones straight into the recruiter’s calendar. It has screened over 150,000 candidates, has paying external customers and a live sales pipeline, and the parent group has committed follow-on funding tied to commercial milestones.

**About the venture:**

The product came out of the group’s own hiring problem. It recruits at volume in health andsocial care, and the same thing kept happening: good candidates applied, nobody called them back quickly enough, and they took jobs elsewhere.

The venture built a voice agent that responds immediately and works evenings, weekends and bank holidays. In production it reaches a 78% contact rate against a 28% manual baseline, and time-to-offer has fallen from eight days to under three. Screening and booking is the starting point.

The vision is to automate the whole recruitment and onboarding journey: every step between a candidate applying and a compliant first day at work. The GM shapes how far and how fast the venture goes after that. The same problem exists in every sector that runs on shift work.

Health and social care is the hardest version of it (regulated, compliance-heavy, and very competitive on speed), which is why the venture sells there first. Light industrial, hospitality, construction and education all have milder versions of it. Part of the job is deciding when to expand beyond care, and not trying to serve every market at once.

The venture has got this far without a full-time commercial leader. Deals sit in the pipeline while selling happens as a side activity, revenue has grown anyway, and there is no written growth plan or support function around the team yet. A founding commercial hire is being recruited alongside you to work the pipeline; producing the growth plan is your first task.

**What you do:**

• Own the venture P&L, revenue and costs.

• Own the product. You set the roadmap and work directly with the engineering team, and voice quality, screening accuracy, latency, drop-off, escalation paths and auditability all sit with you.

• Own pricing and packaging, and change them when market evidence says they are wrong.

• Manage the founding commercial hire day to day. You set their pricing guardrails and pipeline priorities, and the revenue they close counts toward your P&L. The hire is shared with a second venture in the group, so part of their time will eventually move there.

• Sell directly. At this stage the GM carries deals: you run the strategic and first-of-their- kind deals yourself, close alongside the commercial hire until the pattern is established, and feed what buyers tell you back into pricing and product decisions.

• Find the repeatable sales motion in the deals closed so far and the live pipeline, and prove it before spending to scale it.

• Turn the internal deployment and the existing customers into case studies and reference material that persuade outside buyers.

• Hit the commercial milestones that release the follow-on funding.

• Grow the team from its current small base as revenue justifies it.

• Report to the group’s technology leadership and executive team in P&L terms: revenue, cost to serve, pipeline, and what has changed since the last update.

• If the evidence says the venture should stop, or should get more investment, make that case with the numbers.

**What’s expected:**

Knows the venture’s cost to serve, price floor and break-even point, and plans the roadmap around them Product judgment Stays close to the product: listens to real calls, knows where the agent fails and why customers churn, and prioritises the roadmap on revenue and retention rather than on what is technically interesting

Pace and resilience Ships pricing changes, packaging tests and product bets in weeks rather than quarters, and keeps momentum through lost deals, slipped milestones and setbacks

Founder-led sales Sells the product themselves: technical enough to demo it credibly, explain what it can and cannot do, and win the trust objection from buyers in regulated sectors

**Ambiguity:**

# Director, Sales Operations - EMEA and APJ

United Kingdom - Remote

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.   
  
Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.   
  
Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

**This role, in a nutshell:**

Chainguard's international business is past the proving stage — the teams, the motion, and the early wins are in place across both EMEA and APAC. We're looking for a Director, Sales Operations to run the operational engine behind it. You'll lead our existing sales operations team and own the planning, forecasting, territory design, reporting, and process rigor that keep a multi-country, multi-segment, multi-timezone business running at speed. You'll act as the direct revenue operations partner to our GVP, EMEA, our RVP, APAC, and their VPs, reporting into our global Revenue Operations leader — inheriting global standards and systems and adapting them for the realities of selling across UK&I, DACH, the Nordics, France, Benelux, Southern Europe, the Middle East, ANZ, Japan, India, and ASEAN. This is a role for someone who wants to own two regions end-to-end while staying tightly connected to a global function.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead, coach, and develop the existing Sales Operations team supporting EMEA and APAC — set priorities, raise the bar on quality, and grow the team as both regions scale
* Serve as the direct revenue operations partner to the GVP, EMEA, and the RVP, APAC, and their leadership teams — the single point of accountability for planning, forecasting, reporting, and operational decision support across both regions
* Sit in both the EMEA and APAC leadership rhythms: attend and shape leadership meetings, staff meetings, and QBRs, and bring the data and recommendations that let the GVP, the RVP, and their leaders make calls quickly and confidently
* Extend that partnership down the org to regional VPs and front-line managers, while acting as the EMEA and APAC voice inside the global GTM Operations function
* Own annual and in-year territory design across both regions — carve equitable, data-backed territories spanning UK&I, DACH, Nordics, France, Benelux, Southern Europe, the Middle East, ANZ, Japan, India, and ASEAN, accounting for language, entity, segment, and account-potential differences
* Run capacity and coverage modeling for EMEA and APAC: headcount plans, ramp assumptions, quota allocation, and productivity targets tied to the company financial plan — including how a maturing EMEA business and an earlier-stage APAC business warrant different assumptions
* Own the forecast cadence for both regions — weekly pipeline inspection, forecast calls, roll-up accuracy, and the narrative that goes to global sales and finance leadership
* Deliver the operating reporting rhythm for both regions: weekly performance, monthly business reviews, QBRs, and EMEA and APAC inputs to Board materials — surfacing the trends that materially affect the growth trajectory
* Own pipeline health and funnel analytics end-to-end: conversion rates by stage, segment, region, and country; source and campaign contribution; win/loss patterns; and the levers behind each
* Drive data integrity and hygiene standards in Salesforce and the broader GTM stack across both regions — account ownership, hierarchy, segmentation, and reporting fields that hold up under scrutiny
* Partner with global GTM Operations on system and process changes, ensuring EMEA and APAC requirements are represented and that regional adaptations don't fragment the global architecture
* Support sales compensation execution for both regions in partnership with global Sales Ops and Finance — plan rollout, quota letters, and accurate, on-time attainment reporting
* Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, BDR, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to remove friction from the EMEA and APAC GTM process
* Maintain governance and rules of engagement across EMEA and APAC teams and segments, and arbitrate cleanly when coverage or credit questions arise
* Bring region-specific operational requirements — data residency, GDPR and APAC privacy regimes, and local entity and currency considerations — into process and reporting design in partnership with Legal and Finance

**What we're looking for:**

* Deep Sales, Revenue, or GTM Operations experience, including significant time in high-growth Enterprise B2B SaaS, is a must
* Proven experience managing and developing a sales operations team is a must
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-country international territory design, quota allocation, and capacity planning is a must — EMEA experience is essential, APAC exposure is a strong plus
* Hands-on, expert-level Salesforce fluency — reporting, data models, process design, and the judgment to know what belongs in the CRM and what doesn't — is a must
* A track record of running a forecast cadence that sales leadership trusts, with measurable improvement in forecast accuracy, is a must
* Strong analytical foundation: able to break ambiguous problems into concrete components and land on a defensible recommendation
* Excellent communicator who can move between a front-line manager's pipeline question and an executive-level narrative without changing the underlying facts
* Demonstrated success as the trusted operations partner to senior revenue leaders (GVP/VP/GM level) — able to earn a seat in the leadership rhythm, tell them what they need to hear, and be relied on for the numbers
* Proven ability to support multiple regional leaders at once with different levels of business maturity, without defaulting to whichever one is loudest
* Experience operating as a regional leader inside a globally managed function — comfortable inheriting standards, pushing back where they don't fit, and not fragmenting the system
* Working knowledge of the modern GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, HubSpot, CPQ, Sigma/Tableau/Looker) and a strong aptitude for picking up new tools
* Comfort with international operating complexity: multiple currencies, legal entities, languages, data privacy regimes, and a working day that spans EMEA and APAC timezones
* Self-starter who flourishes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and can hold multiple priorities without dropping any
* Willingness to travel across EMEA and APAC and to the US for QBRs and planning cycles (~25%)
* Public sector or regulated-industry GTM operations experience is a plus but not required
* Experience with SQL or building data models directly is a plus but not required

Base Salary Range

£165,000 - £210,000 GBP

### About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

* We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
* We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
* We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
* We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

* **Flexible & Remote-First Culture:** Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
* **Our Approach to Equity:** Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
* **100% Covered Health Insurance:** We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
* **∞ Flexible Time Off:** Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
* **18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave:** We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience supporting gateways and card processing, troubleshooting APIs and integration errors, investigating logs and data, and diagnosing transaction issues. They should be able to interpret technical evidence, identify patterns, and apply a structured approach to problem solving. Strong communication skills are essential, as the role involves managing complex merchant enquiries and collaborating effectively with internal stakeholders.
The merchant is always at the centre of our work. We are looking for people with experience in, and a genuine desire to work in, customer support, helping merchants remove blockers and improve their results. Successful candidates demonstrate ownership, a strong sense of urgency, technical curiosity, and a commitment to quality. Comprehensive payments training will be provided, so prior payments experience is not required where the candidate has a strong technical support and troubleshooting foundation.
The Team
Merchant Product Support is a specialised global technical support function that sits between frontline support and specialist Product or Engineering teams in the ticket flow. Our analysts are product specialists aligned to defined Checkout.com product areas and features. They work closely with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues, improve product functionality, and strengthen the support experience for each product area.
The team is primarily centred in London, with a strategic regional presence in Dublin, Mexico, Dubai, and Shanghai. This distribution provides broad coverage across multiple time zones and enables specialised support for merchants and internal teams.
We are passionate about technology and use state-of-the-art AI capabilities to create better outcomes for our customers. We look for people who are curious, open to new ways of working, and eager to use AI as builders from the outset. Team members are encouraged to develop and improve AI-enabled tools that make technical investigations more effective and help accelerate solutions.
Role Overview
The Analyst I is the foundational specialist tier within Merchant Product Support. The role receives and manages merchant and internal requests across channels such as instant messaging, email, and web forms. Analysts acknowledge requests, investigate and resolve issues within their product scope, apply documented technical procedures, provide clear updates, and work in line with agreed SLAs and quality standards. When an issue requires deeper expertise, they engage the appropriate internal team or escalate to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst with clear evidence and relevant troubleshooting details.
Troubleshooting is at the core of the role. Analysts investigate payment flows, system logs, transaction data, and other technical evidence to diagnose issues, identify recurring patterns, and understand emerging trends. Areas of investigation may include advanced financial investigations, payment transaction anomalies, REST API and integration errors, webhook failures, Vault and tokenisation issues, authentication, fraud detection logic, gateway and card processing issues, platform errors, and changes in payment performance or authorisation rates. The team also supports issues affecting payment methods such as PayPal, KNET, Klarna, SEPA, MB WAY, WeChat Pay, Alipay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
This is a specialist role supported by targeted training designed to build deep expertise in payment flows and enable consistently high-quality problem solving. Analysts use advanced tools and techniques for technical investigation and API debugging while developing the knowledge required to resolve issues efficiently and help merchants maintain successful payment operations.

This isn't a "run a load test before release" role. This is a role where you make performance a first-class concern from day one, where you define the thresholds that decide pass or fail, and where you hold the bar when something is degrading and nobody yet knows why.

* Microservices and distributed systems. You understand service-oriented architectures, dependencies, and the realities of testing a service in isolation — stubbing, mocking, contract boundaries, as well as end-to-end.

Beyond the skills and the experience, we want someone who operates with ownership and independence. You don't wait for permission to improve something. You see a gap in coverage, a flaky test, a missing dashboard — and you fix it. You treat the Wealth Management experience line as yours, and you hold yourself to the same standard you hold the product to.

You're not a gatekeeper. You're a quality enabler. And you make every team you work with better at shipping reliable software.

A primary responsibility of the Head of ICM is the rigorous management of credit risk and the adherence to firm policies and regulatory standards. Effectively to lead a modern credit management platform, the Head of ICM must possess excellent technology skills and a deep, practical understanding of credit workflow systems. The role requires a sophisticated grasp of evolving technology trends, including the integration of real-time data feeds for dynamic risk monitoring and the implementation of predictive modeling for risk forecasting. Under the incumbent's leadership, ICM will drive innovation in credit management processes and systems, offering credit capabilities powered by artificial intelligence and machine learning. By collaborating with business and technology partners to implement solutions, using advanced analytics for predictive credit insights, and enhancing cybersecurity measures, the Head of ICM will capitalise on opportunities for disruptive change to maintain Citi's competitive advantage. Furthermore, a critical focus will be on driving operational efficiencies and achieving operational leverage, ensuring the ICM platform can effectively support increasing business volumes and evolving wholesale lending activities.

The ideal candidate will be a highly effective and distinguished business leader with a minimum of 15 years of risk or risk-related credit work experience within major global banking or financial institutions. This extensive background must reflect deep knowledge of wholesale credit portfolios, credit workflow systems, and a proven track record of executing monitoring strategies and priorities across diverse lines of business and geographies. The candidate must demonstrate strong ethics, unwavering integrity, and the courage to address difficult issues transparently and in a timely manner. As a Service Desk Manager within the Software Developer Support Team (SDST), you will play a key role in leading the day-to-day operation of a busy and customer-focused Service Desk, supporting external software developers, government departments and other API consumers who integrate with HMRC digital services.

You will be responsible for managing the workflow, performance and resources of a team of Service Desk Analysts, ensuring customer contacts are handled efficiently and service standards are maintained. Working closely with operational colleagues, line managers and stakeholders across SDST and wider HMRC teams, you will help ensure work is prioritised effectively, resources are deployed appropriately and operational objectives are achieved.

The role requires a proactive and motivated individual who can monitor service performance, analyse management information and identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. You will use customer feedback, performance data and operational insight to support decision-making, enhance working practices and drive continuous improvement across the Service Desk.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys leading and developing people, solving operational challenges and delivering excellent customer service within a fast-paced environment. You will be expected to build strong working relationships, support colleagues to perform at their best and contribute to the ongoing development of the Service Desk function.

The successful candidate will be a confident communicator with strong leadership and organisational skills, capable of managing competing priorities while maintaining a positive, inclusive and high-performing team culture.

The position may involve people management responsibilities, including coaching, performance management and supporting the professional development of colleagues.

## Location

Leeds Regional Centre - Wellington Place  
Manchester Regional Centre - Three New Bailey  
Telford - Plaza 1 and 2

## Person specification

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Service Desk Manager, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* Leading the day-to-day operation of the Service Desk, ensuring work is effectively prioritised and service levels are achieved.
* Supporting a team of Band O Service Desk Analysts, creating a positive, inclusive and high-performing working environment.
* Monitoring workloads, workflow, performance and resource allocation to ensure customer demand is effectively managed and operational priorities are delivered.
* Acting as an escalation point for complex customer issues, ensuring appropriate ownership, stakeholder engagement and timely resolution.
* Supporting service continuity activities and operational incident management during periods of increased demand, service disruption or major incidents.
* Ensuring operational processes are followed consistently and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness and customer experience.
* Monitoring service performance, developer feedback and management information to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Producing, analysing and interpreting management information to support decision-making, resource planning and service improvement activities.
* Working collaboratively with teams across SDST, CDIO and wider HMRC to maintain effective service delivery and achieve shared outcomes.
* Supporting business continuity, workforce planning and operational resilience activities to ensure the Service Desk remains equipped to meet business demand.
* Contributing to the onboarding, coaching and development of colleagues, supporting them to build capability, confidence and performance.
* Championing teamwork, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across the Service Desk and wider operational team.
* Supporting the Senior Operational Manager in delivering operational objectives, organisational priorities and strategic initiatives.

## Essential Criteria

* Leadership and Team Management: Experience of leading, motivating and developing individuals or teams to achieve performance objectives.
* Stakeholder Management: Experience of building and maintaining effective working relationships with a range of stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.
* Operational Management: Experience of managing workloads, competing priorities and service delivery within a fast-paced operational environment.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience of reviewing processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing practical solutions.
* Data Analysis and Decision Making: Experience of analysing performance information, identifying trends and using data to support decision making and improve outcomes.
* Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences.

## Desirable Criteria

* Experience of working within a Service Desk or customer support environment.
* Experience of performance management and people leadership.
* Experience of creating or using management information, dashboards or reporting tools.
* Experience of working within Agile, Digital or Technology environments.

* Communicating and Influencing

## Things you need to know

**Artificial intelligence**

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

**Selection process details**

This vacancy is using Success Profiles (opens in a new window), and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths and Experience.

## **How to Apply**

As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:

* A name-blind CV including your job history and key achievements from your career which reflects key responsibilities of the role. Provide specific instances from your career detailing successes where you can.
* A 500-word Personal Statement. Your Personal Statement should be used to describe how your skills and experience from your career reflect the Essential Criteria of the role, using specific examples from your career were you can.
* Separate 250-word Behaviour statements on Communicating and Influencing, Managing a Quality Service, and Making Effective Decisions.

Please complete a separate statement (Max 250 words) for the Desirable Criteria where applicable. This is not essential for the role but may be considered by the vacancy-holder where candidates have the same scores at interview.

**Sift**

In the event of a large number of applications, an initial sift may be held on your CV only. Those who pass the initial sift will have their full application reviewed.

At full sift your CV and your Personal Statement will be assessed, with the successful candidates being invited to interview.

We may also raise the score required at any stage of the process if we receive a high number of applications.

**Interview**

The interview will be 45 minutes in duration and will be held by a 3-person panel via video link. During the panel interview, you will be asked behaviour-based questions, behaviours outlined below. You will also be asked strengths based questions to explore what you enjoy and your motivations relevant towards the role.

“It is often said that the customer's needs should come first. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?”

**Behaviours:**

* Communicating and Influencing
* Managing a Quality service
* Making effective decisions

When answering you will be required to provide a specific instance from your career which demonstrates the technical skill, experience or behaviour in question. You would be advised prepare specific examples from you career in advance.

You will be advised to apply the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) technique when delivering examples. You would be encouraged to prepare demonstratable examples of your experience ahead of the interview to ensure meaningfulness and completeness.

**Eligibility**

Please take extra care to tick the correct boxes in the eligibility sections of your application form. Mistakes sometimes happen but if you contact us later than two working days (Monday-Friday) before the vacancy closes, we may not be able to reopen your application for you. Job Description

  

**The role**

The Client and Legal Knowledge Engineer sits within the Client and Legal Knowledge team and supports the evolution of the firm’s knowledge role in an AI-enabled environment. The role helps turn legal knowledge, client knowledge and expert insight into structured, governed and reusable knowledge assets that can be discovered, applied and improved across the firm.

Working across the Client and Legal Knowledge portfolio, the role will identify, shape and support practical use cases that improve how the firm captures, structures, searches, navigates and reuses trusted knowledge. This includes supporting knowledge products, platforms, enterprise search, intranet journeys, guided content experiences, taxonomy, content operations, adoption and AI-enabled knowledge initiatives.

This is a knowledge role with a strong technology component. It combines legal knowledge management, client knowledge, content architecture, product thinking and responsible use of emerging technologies to improve consistency, reuse, productivity and client service while maintaining appropriate governance and confidentiality controls.

**Who you will work with**

You will work as part of the Client and Legal Knowledge team, collaborating with colleagues across Knowledge Products and Platforms, client knowledge, legal knowledge, data, taxonomy, search, content architecture, adoption and knowledge operations.

You will partner with Knowledge Lawyers, client knowledge colleagues, fee earners and practice-facing knowledge teams to understand user needs and identify where trusted knowledge can be structured, automated, surfaced or reused more effectively.

You will also work with Product Managers, IT, Innovation, Risk, Compliance and other business services teams to ensure knowledge solutions are practical, secure, governed and aligned with the firm’s broader knowledge and technology strategy.

**What you will be responsible for**

**Knowledge engineering across the Client and Legal Knowledge portfolio:**

* Design knowledge models, metadata approaches and content structures that support search, AI retrieval, product development and reuse across the Client and Legal Knowledge portfolio.
* Work with Knowledge Lawyers, client knowledge colleagues, product teams and knowledge operations colleagues to identify repeatable workflows, common questions and opportunities for standardisation.
* Ensure knowledge assets are aligned with firm standards, relevant governance requirements and agreed content, metadata and taxonomy principles.

**AI-enabled knowledge solutions:**

* Support the development of AI-enabled knowledge experiences grounded in trusted firm content.
* Help design retrieval, prompt and workflow approaches that improve access to client and legal knowledge.
* Evaluate AI-enabled outputs from a knowledge quality, usability, confidentiality and governance perspective.
* Contribute to guidance and standards for responsible use of AI across legal knowledge products.

**Knowledge Search, taxonomy and discoverability:**

* Take responsibility for seeing agreed search, navigation, taxonomy and intranet improvements through from issue identification to implementation and review.
* Work with Knowledge Lawyers, product colleagues and content owners to design and maintain user-centred navigation routes, including local topic structures, practice area views, knowledge-type filters and task-based journeys.
* Apply and improve knowledge taxonomies, metadata models and content classification approaches, including local topics, knowledge types, jurisdiction, practice area, legal topic, document type and lifecycle status where relevant.
* Use search analytics, user feedback and content performance signals to identify gaps, duplication, poor findability and opportunities to improve the user experience.
* Partner with content owners to ensure intranet pages, knowledge collections and search experiences remain current, well-structured, governed and aligned with agreed taxonomy and metadata standards.

**Client and Legal Knowledge portfolio use cases and adoption:**

* Identify, shape and support practical knowledge engineering use cases across the Client and Legal Knowledge portfolio, including legal knowledge, client knowledge, knowledge products, search, intranet, taxonomy, content operations, adoption and AI-enabled knowledge initiatives.
* Work with colleagues across Client and Legal Knowledge to understand common pain points, repeated requests, user journeys and opportunities to improve how knowledge is created, structured, surfaced, governed and reused.
* Translate portfolio-wide needs into clear requirements, prototypes, pilots and prioritised improvements, ensuring use cases are grounded in trusted content, clear user needs, appropriate governance and practical delivery considerations.
* Connect related activity across content, product, search, taxonomy, data, adoption and operations so that solutions are reusable, scalable and aligned with the firm’s knowledge strategy.
* Measure adoption, user satisfaction and value so that knowledge products and use cases continue to evolve with lawyer, client and business needs.

**What you will do**

**Build the bridge between legal knowledge and technology:**

* Map legal workflows and identify where structured knowledge, automation or AI can reduce duplication and improve consistency.
* Create or shape working prototypes, workflows, pilots and reusable knowledge components in partnership with product and technology teams.
* Define knowledge requirements for system integrations and ensure the right content, metadata and controls are considered from the outset.

**Strengthen the knowledge foundations for AI:**

* Help prepare knowledge content for AI use by improving structure, metadata, summaries, relationships and governance.
* Contribute to controlled pilots involving natural language search, RAG, knowledge assistants, drafting support and workflow automation.

* Support testing and quality review of AI-enabled knowledge outputs, including accuracy, source grounding, confidentiality and usability.

**Enable a high-performing knowledge team:**

* Work across Client and Legal Knowledge workstreams to connect product, content, data, search and operations activity.
* Share practical knowledge engineering methods with colleagues and help build confidence in AI-enabled ways of working.
* Produce clear documentation, guidance and updates so that new tools and processes are understood and adopted.

**Develop and deliver use cases across the Client and Legal Knowledge portfolio:**

* Work with colleagues across Client and Legal Knowledge to turn priority problems into practical, reusable knowledge use cases.
* Support use cases from problem definition through requirements, prototype, pilot, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Get involved hands-on in content review, taxonomy mapping, testing, user feedback analysis, documentation and implementation activity where needed.

**Be hands-on and delivery-focused:**

* Take a proactive, practical approach to moving work forward - identifying what needs to be done, unblocking issues and helping the team deliver.
* Be willing to get into the detail and work hands-on across content, taxonomy, search configuration, testing, documentation, user feedback analysis, clean-up activity and operational tasks where needed.
* Work collaboratively across the team, stepping in to support colleagues and shared priorities rather than focusing only on narrowly defined responsibilities.
* Balance strategic thinking with practical execution, ensuring that ideas are translated into usable, adopted and well-governed knowledge solutions.
* Help maintain momentum on pilots, intranet improvements, taxonomy updates, search enhancements and knowledge product changes by following through on actions and driving work to completion.

  

Qualifications

  

**Your experience**

**Experience, knowledge and capabilities:**

* Experience improving knowledge search, intranet findability, guided content experiences or content discovery in a legal, professional services or enterprise knowledge environment.
* Practical experience applying or maintaining taxonomies, metadata schemas, topic structures, knowledge-type classifications, content standards or controlled vocabularies.
* Experience identifying, shaping or supporting practical knowledge, content, search, automation, intranet or AI-enabled use cases across a team, function or portfolio.
* Ability to work across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups, translating user needs into reusable, scalable and practical knowledge solutions.
* Comfortable working at both conceptual and operational levels -  from designing taxonomy, search and use-case principles through to reviewing content, testing user journeys and helping implement improvements.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a global law firm or professional services environment.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure AI, Copilot, legal AI tools or equivalent platforms.
* Experience supporting pilots, proofs of concept or product enhancements from idea through adoption.
* Familiarity with data governance, permissioned search, metadata quality, knowledge graphs, semantic search or content migration activity.
* Ability to work fluently with technical colleagues without needing to sit as a pure software engineering or data science role.

**Skills and behaviours:**

* Knowledge mindset: understands how legal expertise is captured, curated, reused and governed.
* Product mindset: focuses on user needs, adoption, measurable value and continuous improvement.
* Technology fluency: can work confidently with AI, automation and platform teams while keeping knowledge outcomes central.
* Commercial and client focus: recognises that better knowledge delivery improves consistency, efficiency and client service.
* Collaboration: builds trusted relationships across practice groups, Client and Legal Knowledge, IT, Innovation, Risk and Compliance.
* Judgement: balances innovation with confidentiality, information governance and the need for lawyers to remain accountable for legal outputs.
* Proactivity: spots issues and opportunities, takes ownership and is comfortable suggesting practical ways to improve knowledge discovery, content quality and user experience.
* Delivery and practical problem solving: combines strategic thinking with a willingness to get into the detail, follow through on actions and move between user needs, content detail, taxonomy, search behaviour and operational constraints to deliver pragmatic improvements.
* Team player: works generously and collaboratively, supports shared priorities and is willing to step in where needed to help colleagues and the wider Client and Legal Knowledge team deliver portfolio-wide outcomes.
* Portfolio mindset: understands how different Client and Legal Knowledge products, platforms, content sets and operational processes connect, and looks for opportunities to create reusable solutions across the wider portfolio.

# Customer Support Specialist, Overleaf & Papers AI

**About us**

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.

We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?

**Your new role**Digital Science is dedicated to putting customers at the heart of everything we do. Our portfolio spans products at different stages of maturity — from Overleaf, our widely used scientific and technical writing platform that serves over 30 million researchers, students, and institutions worldwide, to Papers AI, one of our newest research software products, which launched on July 29, 2026 and is growing quickly. Our goal is to provide exceptional support, empower users through self-service resources, and continuously improve the experience across both products.

The Customer Support Specialist role is the connective tissue between two products within Digital Science: Overleaf, our mature, widely-used scientific and technical writing platform built around LaTeX and collaborative authoring, and Papers AI, our newest AI-powered research and writing

tool. You'll deliver hands-on, empathetic support to Overleaf's global base of researchers and institutions, and to Papers AI's early adopters, still shaping its support experience as it grows.  
  
*Please note - due to business need, we can only accept applications from candidates who reside in the UK and the US where we have established legal entities.  
  
If you apply from outside of these areas, your application will not be considered.  
  
Please be aware that we may close this position early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply promptly.*

## What you’ll be doing

* Provide timely, professional, and empathetic email-based support to B2C and B2B users of both Overleaf and Papers AI.
* Handle billing inquiries for both products (e.g., Stripe-based subscriptions), escalating complex billing or account issues as needed.
* Maintain and improve Overleaf’s existing documentation and knowledge base, while building Papers AI’s user-facing help content largely from scratch as common issues emerge.
* Log bug reports to Product and Engineering with clear, reproducible detail.
* Adhere to and refine Overleaf’s established support processes, and help shape a first support playbook for Papers AI as ticket patterns emerge.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Engagement, and Finance teams to support individual users, institutional clients, and enterprise customers across both products.
* Monitor support trends and user feedback across both products, and proactively surface patterns that show up.

## What you’ll bring to the role

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for engaging with customers and internal teams.
* Fluency in English, with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues efficiently, across products with different levels of process maturity.
* Comfort working through ambiguity — Papers AI is early-stage and doesn’t have a mature playbook yet, so some days will look more like building the answer than looking it up.
* Experience in a customer service or support role, preferably within a SaaS platform.

* Familiarity with LaTeX, Overleaf, or similar markup languages and authoring tools.

* Knowledge of SaaS billing platforms such as Stripe.
* Experience working remotely in a distributed team environment.
* Understanding of academic publishing and the needs of researchers and institutions.
* Experience supporting more than one product at once, or building support documentation and processes from scratch for an early-stage product.

We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective.

We are **brave in the pursuit of better**

We are **collaborative and inclusive**

We are **always open-minded**

We are **from and for the community**

*We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. A rich mix of voices drives quality insights, fosters enhanced collaboration, and ultimately pushes knowledge forward more effectively.*

Digital Science is a technology company working to make research more efficient.

We are easyJet - a FTSE listed, £multi-billion low-cost airline that serves tens of millions of customers every single year. If you're reading this, you have probably already been an easyJet customer, and you'll know that there is no more iconic (or Orange!) travel brand in Europe.
