READ ON IF YOU
> Have significant experience leading people analytics, insight or people data teams, alongside ownership of colleague listening or engagement survey programmes.
> Know how to connect listening data with wider people and business metrics to create a clear, joined up view of the workforce and drive meaningful action.
> Can influence senior leaders through compelling insight, robust measurement frameworks and data led storytelling.
> Be in our fantastic Luton head office 3 x per week.

THE TEAM
The People Experience team is focused on creating an outstanding colleague experience across easyJet. As a key member of the People Experience Leadership Team, you'll work closely with People teams, business leaders and our central data functions to make trusted people insight and colleague listening central to business decision making.
You'll lead our people analytics, reporting, data governance and colleague listening capability, including Airwaves, our colleague survey and listening approach. You'll help the business understand what colleagues are experiencing, identify workforce trends and turn insight into action to improve performance, engagement and culture.

THE ROLE
At easyJet, we operate more than 2,000 flights every day during peak summer, generating insight across every part of our operation. This role is about ensuring people data and the colleague voice have a seat at the table alongside commercial and operational metrics.
You'll shape and deliver our people data and analytics strategy, ensuring leaders have access to trusted, forward looking insight that helps them understand workforce trends, anticipate risks and make better decisions. You'll own and evolve the end-to-end people data ecosystem, bringing together data integrity, governance, reporting, analytics and colleague listening into a clear, simple and commercially relevant view of our workforce.
A central part of your remit will be leading the design, delivery and evolution of Airwaves, our colleague survey and listening approach. You'll ensure listening generates faster, deeper and more actionable insight than a traditional engagement survey cycle. By integrating colleague feedback with wider people and business data, you'll create a coherent narrative that identifies what matters most and supports clear priorities, visible action and measurable outcomes.
This is not a purely technical role. You'll combine expertise in data and listening with commercial judgement and strong stakeholder leadership. You'll help leaders ask the right questions, build their confidence in interpreting insight and ensure data is actively used to shape decisions, rather than simply reported.
Your key accountabilities will include;
> Defining and delivering a clear people data, analytics and listening strategy aligned with business priorities.
> Owning and evolving the Airwaves survey and wider colleague listening approach, from design and delivery through to insight, action planning and measurement.
> Connecting listening data with workforce, talent, performance and business measures to provide a joined up view of colleague experience and organisational performance.
> Translating survey results and people data into clear business priorities, actionable recommendations and visible follow through.
> Providing forward looking insight that helps leaders identify workforce risks, trends and opportunities.
> Owning the end to end people data lifecycle, including quality, governance, controls, reporting and analytics.
> Ensuring business critical, statutory and regulatory reporting is accurate, timely, secure and trusted.
> Establishing clear measures, KPIs and insight frameworks that track performance and outcomes.
> Building simple, scalable and increasingly self service reporting capability.
> Developing the capability of leaders, managers and People teams to understand and act on data and colleague feedback.
> Using external benchmarks, market trends and emerging developments in people analytics, AI and workforce insight to keep our approach relevant and competitive.
> Partnering with central data and IT teams to align systems, standards, governance and enterprise decision making.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
> Significant experience leading a people analytics, data or insight function at enterprise scale.
> Essential experience owning or leading a colleague listening or engagement survey programme in a large, complex organisation.
> A strong understanding of listening strategy and survey design, including how to turn colleague feedback into actionable insight, organisational priorities and measurable change.
> Experience integrating engagement or listening data with wider people, workforce and business measures to create a coherent, commercially relevant narrative.
> A track record of ensuring survey insight leads to clear ownership, visible action and meaningful follow through.
> Strong experience building reporting, measurement frameworks and KPIs that support business performance.
> Proven ability to translate complex data and feedback into clear, compelling and actionable insight.
> Experience owning data governance, reporting standards, controls and data quality improvement.
> Strong knowledge of HR data, processes and metrics, with the ability to simplify complexity.
> The credibility and influencing skills to challenge and guide senior leaders.
> Experience developing leader’s, manager’s and People team’s capability to interpret data and act on insight.

> Resilience, adaptability and the ability to operate effectively in a fast changing environment.
> Experience of enterprise or federated data models, analytics tools, BI platforms, HR systems such as Workday, or advanced analytics and AI would be valuable.

> PMI.
> 7%25 pension contributions.

## **Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI Native (f/m/d)**

  
The Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI-Native is responsible to build, integrate, and expand the backend services that power the company's evolving modular e-commerce platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on connecting core e-commerce capabilities including personalization, semantic and LLM-driven search and discovery, Digital Asset Management (DAM), Product Information Management (PIM), and internal SAP/HANA systems. The role will design and develop APIs, services, data flows, and integrations that allow these platforms to work together reliably at scale. A defining requirement for this position is an AI-native development mindset: the successful candidate will use AI coding agents as a normal part of the software development lifecycle to generate, refactor, test, debug, document, and improve code while applying strong engineering judgment, security practices, and human review. The ideal candidate combines strong backend engineering fundamentals, systems integration experience, curiosity, and the ability to move quickly in a modern AI-assisted development environment.

job_title: Software Engineer III, Site Reliability Engineering - Ventures
job_description:
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The future of entertainment is interactive, and our Ventures Group plays an important role in this future by building content, culture, and community that take us Beyond Gaming. We empower audiences to Play, Create, Watch, and Connect across our amazing franchises and experiences, including The Sims, Madden NFL, EA SPORTS FC, Apex Legends, and Battlefield. We’re a multi-functional group, with world-class expertise in building fandom, driving interactive storytelling, and positioning our franchises at the center of the broader entertainment ecosystem.

We are seeking a Software Engineer III (Site Reliability Engineering) on a six-month temporary full time contract to strengthen how we run and observe the services behind our Ventures products. The priority for this engagement is observability and incident response, followed by cloud cost and governance, then security posture. Infrastructure provisioning and build pipelines are largely self-managed by our backend and platform team, so you will support and improve those areas rather than own them outright.

You will work primarily in AWS, with some workloads in GCP, alongside internally provided EA infrastructure and platform services. Because this is a fixed-term engagement, we are looking for someone who can be productive early, leave behind well-documented and reproducible work, and hand over cleanly at the end of the contract.

We are building an agentic operating model. Agents automatically inspect issues, correlate signals, and propose remediations, with a human reviewing and confirming before anything is applied. We want someone who is energised by this way of working and who wants to help shape it, while bringing the judgement to know when an agent’s suggestion is wrong.

### Key Responsibilities:

Observability and incident response (primary focus)

•       Design and build observability across Ventures environments, including logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.

•       Define meaningful service level indicators and alert thresholds so that teams are paged on real problems rather than noise.

•       Lead and improve incident response practice, including triage, escalation paths, on-call rotation, and runbooks.

•       Run post-incident reviews and drive the follow-up actions that come out of them.

•       Give product engineering teams the visibility they need to diagnose issues in their own services.

Cloud cost and governance

•       Establish visibility of cloud spend across Ventures projects in AWS and GCP.

•       Identify and implement cost efficiency improvements, and set up guardrails to prevent regressions.

•       Define and enforce tagging, account, and resource conventions so that spend and ownership are attributable.

•       Report on cost trends and forecast implications for engineering leadership.

Security posture

•       Review and improve secrets management, IAM and least-privilege access, and network configuration.

•       Work with EA security and platform teams to align Ventures infrastructure with internal standards.

•       Surface and help remediate infrastructure security risks across projects.

Agentic operations

•       Build and refine agentic workflows that automatically inspect incidents, correlate telemetry, and propose remediations for human confirmation.

•       Make our systems legible to agents, including structured telemetry, machine-readable runbooks, and well-scoped tooling.

•       Review agent-proposed actions and remain accountable for what gets applied, treating suggestions as input rather than answers.

•       Track where agentic workflows perform well and where they do not, and feed that back into how they are designed.

Infrastructure and delivery support

•       Support the backend and platform team on Terraform and infrastructure as code, contributing modules and improvements where useful.

•       Support and improve existing CI/CD pipelines where they create friction for product teams, without taking over ownership.

•       Integrate with internally provided EA infrastructure and platform services, and work with those teams to unblock delivery.

•       Document your work, including runbooks and operational procedures, to a standard the team can own after the contract ends.

### How Your Success Will Be Measured:

•       Coverage and usefulness of monitoring and alerting across Ventures environments.

•       Time to detect, respond to, and resolve incidents, and the quality of post-incident follow-through.

•       Demonstrable reduction or better control of cloud spend, with clear attribution by project.

•       Measurable improvements in security posture across Ventures infrastructure.

•       Reduced operational friction for product engineering teams.

•       Growth in the coverage and accuracy of agentic workflows, and in the confidence the team has in acting on their output.

•       Quality of documentation and handover, measured by the team’s ability to operate independently at contract end.

•       Effective collaboration with the backend and platform team and with EA platform and security teams.

### What You Bring:

•       5+ years of professional SRE, DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering experience.

•       Strong experience implementing observability using tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch.

•       Proven experience running incident response in a production environment, including on-call and post-incident review.

•       Experience managing and optimising cloud cost at organisational scale, including tagging and governance practices.

•       Solid understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including secrets management, least-privilege access, and network segmentation.

•       Strong hands-on AWS experience across compute, networking, storage, IAM, and managed services.

•       Working knowledge of GCP, or clear evidence of operating comfortably in a multi-cloud environment.

•       Practical Terraform experience, sufficient to contribute confidently to an existing infrastructure as code estate.

•       Familiarity with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar.

•       Experience with containerisation and orchestration, including Docker and Kubernetes.

•       Strong scripting ability in Python, Bash, Go, or similar.

•       Experience working alongside internal platform or shared infrastructure teams within a larger organisation.

•       Hands-on experience using AI coding or operations agents in real work, and a clear view on where they help and where they should not be trusted.

•       A track record of joining an existing environment and becoming productive quickly.

### Soft Skills & Values:

•       Self-directed and comfortable making progress with limited ramp-up time.

•       Pragmatic, with good judgement about what to fix now and what to document and leave.

•       Genuinely enthusiastic about agentic workflows, and equally willing to say when an agent has got it wrong.

•       Comfortable improving systems owned by other teams without stepping on them.

•       Clear communicator, able to work with engineers and non-technical partners alike.

•       Writes things down, and leaves systems easier for others to run than they found them.

•       Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

•       Commitment to inclusivity, trust, and continuous improvement.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

# Senior Manager, People Partnering

* Full-time

## Company Description

Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.  
   
From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

## Job Description

**Shape the people agenda behind meaningful transformation — while staying close to the work.**  
  
As a Manager People Partnering, you will combine senior business partnering with leadership responsibility for part of our People Partner team. You will partner directly with executives and senior leaders, lead colleagues and priorities within the People Partner community, and personally deliver complex People initiatives across an international organisation.

**The opportunity**

This is a senior, hands-on role at the intersection of business, people and transformation. You will lead part of the People Partner team, coaching and supporting colleagues, coordinating priorities and helping ensure we provide consistent, commercially relevant and high-impact partnership to the business.

At the same time, you will be the dedicated People Partner for an assigned business group, working directly with executives and senior leadership teams. You will advise on organisation, talent and workforce decisions and personally lead complex People activities — from restructurings and employee relations cases to M&A integration and organisational change.

This is not a role where leadership means stepping away from delivery. You will be comfortable moving from an executive discussion into the practical detail required to make decisions happen.

* Lead and contribute to the People Partner team
* Lead, coach and develop part of the People Partner team, creating clarity around priorities and supporting high-quality delivery.
* Coordinate capacity, priorities and cross-functional activities within your area, working closely with other People Partner leaders and regional teams.
* Act as an escalation and sparring partner for complex People matters, helping colleagues navigate difficult business, employee and organisational situations.
* Contribute to the continued development of the People Partner model, sharing practical tools, experience and best practice across the wider team.
* Support the People Partner Learning Academy and help strengthen the capability and consistency of People Partners across the organisation.

**Partner with executives and senior leaders**

* Own the People agenda for an assigned business group, acting as a trusted adviser to executives, senior leaders and their leadership teams.
* Build a strong understanding of the business, its commercial priorities and organisational challenges and translate these into practical People priorities.
* Use people data, business insight and judgement to advise on organisation design, workforce planning, talent, succession, performance, engagement and leadership capability.
* Challenge constructively when required and turn leadership decisions into clear actions and tangible outcomes.
* Move comfortably between strategic discussions and hands-on execution.

**Lead complex change and M&A**

Personally lead People workstreams for restructurings, reorganisations, workforce changes, acquisitions and post-merger integration.

Bring practical M&A experience across areas such as due diligence, employee transfer, consultation, people risk, organisation design, communications and integration planning.

Translate integration strategy into practical delivery. This might mean reviewing compensation and benefits across an acquired organisation and developing a **benefits harmonisation approach**, identifying employee and cost impacts, coordinating stakeholders and managing implementation.

Lead restructuring and redundancy programmes across multiple jurisdictions, working through impacted populations, local legal requirements, consultation processes, timelines, documentation, communications and manager preparation.

Coordinate stakeholders across People, Legal, Finance, Reward, leadership teams and local experts, while remaining personally accountable for driving the work forward.

**Employment law, employee relations and risk**

* Provide pragmatic guidance and personally handle complex employee relations matters including performance, capability, disciplinary, grievance, absence, redundancy, consultation and senior employee exits.
* Apply strong working knowledge of employment law and employee relations across multiple jurisdictions, partnering with Legal and local specialists where appropriate.
* Work effectively with employee representatives, works councils and unions where applicable, including complex consultations and negotiations.
* Balance business objectives, employee experience and legal risk and give leaders clear options and recommendations rather than purely procedural advice.

**Organisation development and culture**

* Help leaders build organisations that are clear, capable and ready for what comes next.
* Bring practical organisational development expertise to organisation design, organisational effectiveness, culture, leadership capability, engagement and change adoption.
* Support leaders through organisation design and workforce decisions, including roles, structures, spans and layers, capabilities and talent implications.
* Connect People interventions to business outcomes and ensure agreed actions move from discussion into implementation.

## Qualifications

**What you will bring**

Significant experience as a Senior HR Business Partner, Senior People Partner or comparable role in a complex, international organisation, including experience **partnering directly with executives and senior leadership teams**.

Experience leading, coaching or managing HR Business Partners or People Partners, combined with a strong desire to remain actively involved in day-to-day business partnering and delivery.

A track record of **personally leading M&A and integration activities**, including practical experience with areas such as due diligence, benefits or policy harmonisation, employee transfer, consultation, organisation design, communications or post-merger integration.

Hands-on experience delivering **restructures, redundancies or workforce transformation across multiple jurisdictions**, including the practical implementation required to take a programme from decision through consultation to completion.

Strong, practical knowledge of employment law and employee relations across more than one jurisdiction.

* A free night at The Hoxton every year, plus a little extra £££ when you reach those big milestones.
* Lots of opportunities to grow, progress or switch things up as part of a global family of brands.
* Training to help you settle into your role, learning academies to broaden your skills and development opportunities that help you think, make and thrive at work.
* Extra time off to volunteer with one of our partner charities and make a positive impact in the community.
* Regular team get-togethers, from team drinks to our pretty special bi-annual parties - we know how to have a good time!
* Enhanced family leave for when you’re expanding your family.
* An annual diversity and inclusion calendar packed with opportunities to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact.

**What you'll do...**

* With the support of the hotel Revenue Management teams, you’ll take ownership of the revenue strategy across your region. Working closely with our General Managers and Directors of Sales, you’ll turn the wider commercial vision into clear, actionable plans that grow revenue across every segment. You’ll keep a close eye on performance, spot opportunities and adjust course when needed to keep us on track.
* You’ll lend your expertise to other hotels across the region, supporting them with revenue, sales and marketing processes, systems, pricing, strategy and reporting.
* Collaboration is a big part of the role. You’ll regularly bring together Revenue Management, General Managers, Sales, Brand and Digital teams to make smart, joined-up decisions across market segments and distribution channels.
* You’ll lead the Reservations function across the region, looking for new and better ways of working while taking ownership of recruitment, team leadership, performance and development, as well as the smooth running of the day-to-day operation.
* You’ll coach and develop our property-based revenue leaders and wider commercial teams, helping them grow their confidence, capability and commercial thinking.
* You’ll create a culture where people work together, take ownership and are focused on delivering great results.
* You’ll keep a close eye on the numbers and the story behind them, identifying key trends across pace, group pace, booking windows, booking channels and more, and clearly setting out the actions we’re taking in response.
* You’ll own the delivery of our rooms revenue goals, including budget and RevPAR Index, with a particular focus on growing direct web bookings and improving profitability.
* You’ll support our revenue leaders in preparing monthly forecasts, including a daily breakdown of occupancy, rate and market segment mix, while continually reviewing performance against forecast.
* Together with the hotel Revenue Management teams, HODs and regional teams, you’ll prepare and present monthly rooms revenue performance to our owners.
* You’ll play a key role in property performance reviews with asset managers and owners, confidently talking through results, opportunities and actions.
* You’ll support the preparation of each hotel’s annual revenue budget, keep performance under regular review and communicate with owners as needed throughout the year.
* You’ll stay curious about what’s happening around us, keeping an eye on competitor activity, revenue management practices, new hotel developments and the local demand drivers shaping each market.
* Together with your team, you’ll bring the local market knowledge and commercial insight that help keep The Hoxton one step ahead.
* You’ll build and maintain strong relationships with our third-party partners, including OTA market managers.
* You’ll oversee channel management across the local Revenue teams, making sure rates and inventory are loaded accurately and managed effectively.
* Together with your team, you’ll look after the Revenue Management System, validating forecasts, reviewing the decisions it produces and making sure its configuration and ongoing maintenance support the best possible commercial outcomes.
* You’ll support the technical onboarding of new systems and tools across the region, getting hands-on with set-up, testing, training and troubleshooting so that teams feel confident using them and get the most from them.
* When a Revenue Management leader is away or a role is temporarily vacant, you’ll make sure the hotel has the right revenue support in place—keeping strategy, pricing, forecasting and reporting moving without missing a beat.
* You’ll keep pushing us forward across revenue and distribution, exploring smarter ways of working (including AI-enabled analysis, automation and reporting) to improve accuracy, speed and commercial performance.

### Qualifications

**What we're looking for...**

* You’ll bring significant hotel revenue management experience, ideally with responsibility for multiple properties or a wider region.
* You know your way around pricing, distribution, forecasting and commercial strategy, and can turn all that data into clear decisions that make a real difference to performance.
* You’ll have experience working within lifestyle, luxury or international hotel environments and understand what it takes to balance strong commercial performance with a distinctive guest experience.
* You’re confident influencing senior stakeholders, challenging thinking when needed and bringing people with you (not simply telling them what the numbers say).
* You have strong analytical and financial acumen, with an eye for the detail without losing sight of the bigger commercial picture.
* You’re comfortable with revenue management systems, market intelligence platforms and hotel technology, and you’re always curious about how new tools and smarter ways of working could help us do things better.
* You’re a clear and engaging communicator, a confident presenter and a supportive leader who gets the best out of people.
* You thrive in a fast moving, entrepreneurial environment where plans can change, opportunities appear quickly and everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves.
* You’re collaborative, open-minded and happy to leave your ego at the door. You’ll work across teams, functions and hotels to find the best answer for the business (not just your own area).
* You’re comfortable challenging the norm, asking “why?” and trying something new when there’s a smarter way forward.
* Most importantly, you’ll be yourself. No clones in suits for us. We want someone with personality, good judgement and their own point of view, someone who takes the work seriously, without taking themselves too seriously.

### Senior Strategy Analyst / Principal Strategy Analyst (depending on experience)

Customer - Strategy & Advisory - London, Greater London

---

About the Role

EnterpriseAlumni provides alumni engagement and community-building solutions and services to large, blue-chip organisations, including major financial institutions and global brands. We are growing our management consulting function within the business, reporting directly to our Chief Customer Officer, to work at a strategic level with our largest and most complex customers.

The core of our business is software as a service, and we are fundamentally a technology company focused on the corporate alumni ecosystem.

This role sits above day-to-day platform delivery and services, focused on high-value, evolving engagements with senior customer stakeholders. We are expanding our consultative arm to strategically support customers who want to benefit from our market-leading experience and expertise, whether they are currently using our software, launching an alumni program from scratch, or seeking to take their current approach to new heights. The successful candidate will have a chance to help shape the function and grow their career, while delivering within a critical business line.

The strategy analyst will work directly with senior executives and leaders on the customer side in well-known brands, particularly those in the professional services and financial services sectors - think CMO, Global Heads, and equivalent. This is high-value, high-visibility corporate work. While the nature of the deliverables will continue to evolve as the function grows, the work will consistently demand polish, resilience, and the ability to hold your own in a room with senior corporate leadership as well as our CEO, CCO, and leadership.

Key Responsibilities

* Own strategic, high-value engagements with a portfolio of large enterprise customers, building relationships and rapport with senior stakeholders up to C-Suite level.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers, consistently going beyond the letter of statements of work to support and shape how customers think about their global corporate alumni engagement, change leadership, change management and impact on their business.
* Represent EnterpriseAlumni professionally and credibly in front of senior corporate leadership, both remotely and in person.
* Design and deliver bespoke strategies, including planning and deliverables tailored to individual customer needs, recognising that the scope of this work will continue to evolve.
* Travel to customer sites and events as required, with potentially short international stays.
* Work to fixed, non-negotiable deadlines driven by customer commitments, campaigns, and corporate calendars.
* Collaborate with Customer Success, Product, and Sales colleagues to ensure a joined-up customer experience, while maintaining a distinct, strategic remit.

Person Specification

Experience

* 5–8 years' relevant experience in change management, management consulting, or change leadership.
* Proven track record working with large, blue-chip or enterprise customers at a senior level.
* Demonstratable comfort engaging and building rapport with C-suite/senior marketing, business development, and other functional stakeholders (e.g. CMO, CRO, CHRO).
* Working in a mature start up or scale up environment.

Essential Criteria

* Background in high-value, complex corporate or professional services work which does not need to be traditional management consulting, however the calibre and rigour of the work should be comparable.
* Familiarity with using AI as part of everyday business operations.
* Comfortable creating simplicity from complexity and working with structure and precision.
* Track record of managing continually evolving deliverables and scope, rather than a fixed, repeatable service.
* Resilient, dynamic, and high-energy, with the stamina for demanding customer-facing work, excellent presentations, and interpersonal confidence.
* Accomplished at navigating through ambiguity in internal and external contexts.
* Attention to detail, superlative writing and self-editing skills, and disciplined communication skills.
* Facility for context-switching and adjusting to cultural, political, and social contexts, especially internationally.
* Highly disciplined, with experience working to fixed, non-moveable deadlines.
* Open to regular travel (specific destinations to be confirmed as the customer base develops).

Desirable Criteria

* Work history in/serving financial services, professional services, or large enterprise/corporate accounts.
* Prior exposure to SaaS, B2B technology, or community/engagement platforms, particularly for customers in regulated environments where security, compliance, and governance are critical.
* Familiarity with functions like business development, marketing, HR, or change management in large enterprises.
* Experience helping to scale a function or team.

Base salary will be £45,000-£80,000 annually, depending on experience. This role is office based (5 days per week), with attendance at client sites as required. 

At the heart of our company is EA DNA - the essence that connects our six core values and shapes how we work every day. It guides every decision, behavior and interaction, and defines the way we do business. When you join us, you become part of a team that truly lives these values: People First, Customer at Our Core, Think Commercially, One Team, Own It, and Urgency. These principles shape your experience here - how we support you, how we work together, and how we deliver for our customers.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume, and a brief cover letter explaining why they are the perfect fit for this role.

Recruitment Process

* Stage 1 — Initial telephone screening
* Stage 2 — Teams interview(s)
* Stage 3 — In-person interview at our London offices taking place in first two weeks of October
* Anticipated start date: November 2, 2026

EnterpriseAlumni is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM hygiene and pipeline management within HubSpot.
* Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Product to maximise commercial opportunities and share customer feedback.
* Lead by example, bringing energy, accountability and motivation to the wider commercial team.

About you 

* Proven experience managing and developing a successful B2B sales team, ideally within SaaS.
* Demonstrable experience recruiting, onboarding and developing high-performing sales professionals.
* Strong understanding of the full end-to-end sales process with experience coaching others through complex opportunities.
* Experience with MEDDPICC, CHAMP or similar sales methodologies is desirable.
* Highly data driven, using KPIs, conversion metrics, forecasting and pipeline analysis to drive performance.
* Experience creating, managing and optimising sales territories.
* Commercially minded with excellent forecasting and pipeline management skills.
* A motivational leader who builds an engaging, accountable and high-performing culture.
* Creative and solution focused, always looking for better ways to improve results and processes.
* Excellent coaching, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Resilient, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* A genuine passion for helping charities succeed through technology.

What you’ll get 

* We celebrate together with an early Friday finish with optional team drinks, team incentives, and a variety of company socials.
* We believe work-life balance matters and have flexible hours, working from home, and support part-time work
* We believe in giving back and give you one paid day to fundraise for a charity of your choice.
* We want you to travel well with the Cycle to Work scheme and a London-based office.
* We will support your journey through our learning and development program with an allowance for training each year and Personal Development Plans, as well as a mentor program that offers structured support from senior team members.
* Holiday allowance: 25 days holiday and bank holidays (33 in total). We increase holidays based on length of service, so for every year you’re with us, you’ll get an additional day’s holiday up to 28 days. We also offer an additional 5 days of unpaid holiday.
* A Wellbeing Day!
* Enthuse Wings! Work from abroad for up to 4 weeks of the year!
* Private health insurance coverage
* Places for Races, as partners of London Marathon Events and Great Run, we get access to a number of participant places for major fundraising events. So if you're a keen runner, swimmer or cyclist - you could be in luck.

Come as you are. Love what you do. 

At Enthuse, we want to create a positive impact on a global scale. And to do that we know that the people at Enthuse have to reflect all global lives and identities.

We work flexible hours, we support remote working, and if that doesn’t quite work, we will definitely listen to what will. We’re striving to create a place where all feel valued and welcome — and would love to hear how we could do that for you.

No matter what your background, identity, or even if your experience doesn’t exactly match — we’d love to hear from you!

Our Values  

Be enthusiastic: We are can-do and proactive

Be curious: We believe progress is made by asking questions

Be reliable: You can trust us to get the job done

Who are we?
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
Build Your Career in Data Centers
Many of our technicians join Equinix from commercial buildings, facilities management, building services, manufacturing, healthcare, utilities, and industrial maintenance backgrounds and go on to build successful long-term careers in data center operations.
This role provides exposure to a broad range of electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including critical power, cooling, and facility systems that support reliable 24/7 operations across one of Europe's largest data center campuses. You'll have opportunities to expand your technical knowledge, gain valuable experience across complex infrastructure systems, and progress into more senior technical, operational, or leadership roles.
Whether your goal is to deepen your expertise in electrical or mechanical systems, become an Authorised Person, move into operations leadership, or develop a long-term career in critical facilities, Equinix provides the training, support, and development opportunities to help you get there.
As a global data center company, Equinix offers the stability of an established organisation combined with genuine opportunities for career progression. Alongside a competitive salary, employees benefit from company pension contributions, private medical insurance, life assurance, and a range of wellbeing and employee support programmes.
About the Role
As a Electrical or Mechanical Technician, you'll be responsible for maintaining the electrical and mechanical infrastructure that supports the day-to-day operation of the Slough Campus.
You'll work on systems including LV electrical distribution, switchgear, UPS systems, standby generators, cooling and HVAC equipment, pumps, water treatment systems, fire detection and suppression systems, and Building Management Systems (BMS). Through planned maintenance, inspections, testing, fault finding, and repairs, you'll help ensure these systems remain safe, operational, and maintained to a high standard.
Working as part of a shift team, you'll respond to alarms and equipment issues, support maintenance activities, coordinate contractors, and play a key role in keeping essential infrastructure running reliably across the campus.
What You'll Do
Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and routine inspections.
Respond to equipment alarms, faults, and reactive maintenance requests.
Diagnose and repair electrical and mechanical systems.
Operate and maintain:
LV electrical systems
UPS systems
Standby generators
Switchgear
Cooling and HVAC equipment
Pumps and water treatment systems
Fire detection and suppression systems
Building Management Systems (BMS)
Complete operational checks, testing, and system inspections.
Accurately record maintenance activities, inspections, and shift reports.
Coordinate and oversee specialist contractors carrying out maintenance works.
Follow permit-to-work procedures and safe systems of work.
Support incident response and equipment recovery activities.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and high operational standards across the campus.
What You'll Bring
Essential
Experience maintaining electrical or mechanical infrastructure within commercial buildings, facilities management, building services, industrial, manufacturing, healthcare, utilities, or similar environments.

Most organisations have now run their AI experiments. Far fewer have got anything into production that holds up under real load, real data and real scrutiny.

You would be our most experienced AI practitioner in the UK, working closely with engineering teams and senior client stakeholders. The role has four parts:

* New business. Identifying and shaping opportunities, and leading the technical side of proposals and pitches.
* Growing the team. Mentoring, training and hiring, so that AI capability is shared across the team rather than held by one person.

##### **What you’ll be responsible for**

* Setting the technical direction for AI and data work across Futurice UK, and being responsible for the quality of what we build
* Architecting and building production AI systems: agentic applications, retrieval and knowledge systems, applied ML, and the data platforms beneath them
* Establishing how we evaluate AI systems, so that quality, cost, latency and risk are measured rather than assumed
* Advising client leadership on AI strategy, operating model, build-versus-buy, and moving from pilot to production
* Designing governance, privacy, security and responsible AI practice into the work from the start
* Leading the technical shaping of new opportunities: qualification, solution design, estimation and pitches

We’d love to hear from you if you have:  
  
**Technical depth**

* Production AI systems. Experience taking LLM-based and agentic systems into production and supporting them afterwards, and a clear view of what separates a working demo from a production system.
* Agentic architecture. Tool use, planning and execution loops, multi-agent orchestration, memory and state, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and failure recovery, with attention to the surrounding system rather than the model alone.
* Context engineering. Retrieval strategy, chunking and compaction, caching, structured inputs, freshness, and the associated cost trade-offs.
* Evaluation and observability. Eval design, systematic error analysis, the limits of LLM-as-judge, regression suites for non-deterministic systems, and tracing agent behaviour in production. We treat this as central.
* Retrieval and knowledge systems. Hybrid search, re-ranking, evaluating retrieval quality in its own right, graph-based approaches, and judgement about when retrieval is not the right approach.
* Model selection and adaptation. Choosing between frontier, small and open-weight models, or none at all. Fine-tuning, distillation and RL-based post-training, and a sense of when none of them are needed.
* Classical ML and data science. Forecasting, optimisation, causal inference, recommendation and anomaly detection. A good deal of useful work is not generative.
* Data and platform foundations. Pipelines and orchestration, lakehouse and streaming patterns, data contracts and quality, semantic layers and lineage. Data foundations often set the limit on what a client can do with AI.
* Cloud and operations. Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure or GCP,

* Developing others. Mentoring, running internal training, documenting what the team learns, and helping us interview and assess AI and data talent.

Responsible for ensuring all products & product quality/ food safety processes comply with specified requirements. Maintaining and assisting the QA Manager to deliver continuous improvement in your areas of responsibility and across the site, whilst encouraging best practice at all levels within the organisation to promote a right first-time approach to quality. Effectively control and drive internal product safety and quality records within the business to keep all parties appropriately informed, whilst maintaining control of the process and outcomes.

**Hours/ Shift Patterns:** 12 Hour shifts working a 4 day on 4 day off pattern, alternating between 4 day shifts 6am – 6pm to 4 night shifts 6pm – 6am

**Job Summary**

Health, Safety & Welfare

The welfare of your colleagues is paramount, and you must promote and support a safe working environment and foster a culture of “safety first”.

* Ensure the working environment, equipment, plant, and people always meet with internal health and safety standards through specified start up checks and periodic online checks.
* Where hazards are identified, and risk levels are deemed unacceptable immediate action must be taken by you to remove the hazard or where this is not possible reduce the risk to acceptable levels. Hazards and actions must be recorded through near miss tool/ hold tool/ shift reports/ foreign body tool as necessary.
* Completion of risk assessments as coordinated by the QA Manager through scheduled requirements or where circumstances, equipment or people change from previously agreed standards.
* Ensure safe systems of work, standard operating procedures and health and safety requirements as documented under the GPN (Middlesbrough) Health, Safety and Welfare Manual are always followed. Where practices have moved or where improvements are possible, report these to the QA Manager or EHS Manager in good time for consideration.
* Support and drive the business accident prevention initiatives through the reporting of potential accidents through the Near Miss reporting tool.

Food Safety & Legality

Maintaining the integrity of our products and therefore the business itself is an absolute.  You must ensure this is always the case as we never knowingly compromise product safety, authenticity of legality.

* Responsible for ensuring the CCP’s are under control on a daily basis by documented periodic checks and verification of documented checks by production Operational Line Leaders and Senior Operators.
* Ensure all safety and quality requirements are complied with at all times.
* Ensure the positive release of production lines when moving from a gluten product to a gluten free product through a specified method of rapid allergen swabbing. Ensure results are documented and communicated to site teams.

Quality

Never knowingly compromise on quality, striving for the highest possible standards of quality in our

products, people and plant.

* Ensure all products meet the requirements of the internal specifications and are produced in line with the requirements of the Quality Management System. This will be ensured through completion of quality documentation in accordance with policies, procedures and work instructions.
* Ensure all relevant BRCGS, customer and regulatory standards are met and maintained as specified by the QA Manager and the Quality Management System.
* Ensure product quality by ensuring specifications and customer requirements are met.
* Ensure glass and hygiene audits are carried out as scheduled.
* Ensure product reference samples are maintained and ensure the testing of finished products and hygiene/ micro swabs in line with the sample plan.

* Ensure shelf-life testing of finished products is carried out as required.
* Issue and monitor controlled documents, site procedures, policies, work instructions and record sheets to production teams as required for all areas which affect food safety, quality, authenticity and legality.
* Adhere to document control procedure.

* Ensure the identification, issue and control of safety knives, scissors and scrapers in accordance with documented procedure.
* Verification of powders through pre-production tasting where appropriate in conjunction with production teams.
* Ensure collection of samples for daily taste panels. Ensure attendance with documented records retained.

* Report, investigate, log and communicate foreign body incidents and near misses.
* Liaise with Operations management and production personnel to ensure good manufacturing practices are followed and that good standards of hygiene and housekeeping are maintained.
* Ensure bi-daily GMP audits are carried out and findings acted upon in a timely manner. Ensure the required high standard of housekeeping and GMP across the site is always maintained.
* Ensure a daily audit of QA and production records is carried out and findings communicated to site teams.

* Recording and reporting of any non-conformances. Implement corrective actions as required and completion of reports, supporting RCA investigations.
* Monitor any held/ rejected stock incidents ensuring physical segregation/ identification and SAP quarantine of stock. Maintain hold and SAP systems to ensure full traceability.
* Investigate as appropriate any customer complaints as required by the QA Manager
* Support the operations team in ensuring all process monitoring requirements are completed in good time to the required standards.

* Highlight any material quality issues to the Operations and Supplier Quality Assurance Teams to ensure appropriate action is taken.
* Ensure a strong and open working relationship is maintained with the Operations and Supplier Quality Assurance Teams to be confident of high standards of communication to reduce the likelihood of product safety or quality failures.

* Actively champion quality by leading and participating in quality initiatives that can be acted upon by the site teams to deliver higher levels of quality and consistency.
* Drive to exceed the business Product Safety and Quality targets as communicated by the QA Manager.
* Participate in training and briefings as required, relating to food safety and quality issues.
* Carry out investigations and projects as directed by the QA Manager.
* Participate in BRCGS/ Customer audits as required.
* Responsible for the control and updating of all factory documentation to stay in line with company procedures and SOP’s.

People / Structure / Team Development

You must develop the best in everyone within their roles to ensure our success in achieving legal, customer, business, and individual targets.

* Identify skill gaps or training needs and highlight to the QA Manager and Training Coordinator
* Flexibility within the role towards the business needs to ensure holiday and absence cover within the team.
* Where opportunity lies for improving performance in Operations teams or individuals with regard to quality or safety you are to provide coaching as required and communicate to Operations Management
* Ensure the Quality Toolbox Initiative is communicated to the QA Team and the wider site team as necessary.
* Ensure the RCA tool is used by all QA Technicians with records maintained.

Communication

Good quality communications at the right time will ensure the highest standards of teamwork from all your colleagues within the business and make certain we are all pulling together in the right direction.

* Understanding of the quality KPI’s and wider operations teams and how your role can influence achievement.
* Maintain communications with the support functions of operations: Engineering, Warehouse, Production, R&D and The Technical Department to harness the wider team in delivering your targets.
* Responsible for attending daily operations meetings to relay any information relating to quality and quality documentation.

Planning & Control

You must maintain a structured approach to the delivery of the site strategy plan and the business targets, being aware of how you can positively contribute.

* Ensure and maintain the appropriate storage of both samples and quality assurance records to provide quick access and ease of identification in the case of any investigation or enquiry. Ensure retained samples are effectively rotated.
* Monitor aged stock and liaise with Operations teams to meet quality and food safety requirements whilst endeavouring to meet production plans.
* Carryout testing methods and techniques of quality indicators such as water activity/ calibrations/ weight data/ probe calibration/ chemical concentrations, ensuring an appropriate level of assurance and a strong due diligence defence.

Cost & Efficiencies

* Meeting standards consistently to achieve the cost base to continue our growth and drive world class performance, whilst always striving to find a better way.
* Ensure effective cost control through best use of resources including QA consumables, minimisation of waste and maximisation of efficiency.
* Stringent adherence to all systems & procedures must be adopted by you. Early identification of ineffective procedures with proposed solutions. Ensure all performance logs, SAP inputs and reports are completed in a timely and accurate manner.
* You are encouraged to put forward project suggestions for process and cost improvements.
* Actively promote improvement activities to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the team to deliver best return for the business first.

**Workplace**

The role is primarily based in the production/ warehouse areas, in a typical modern food manufacturing environment, although you may be required to work in other areas of the business from time to time.

**Qualifications**

* Previous food industry experience is essential, ideally time spent within the Quality/Technical department.
* Level 3 Food Hygiene
* HACCP qualification or experience
* Computer literacy (Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook) and SAP if possible
* Desirable: SAP knowledge, BRCGS experience, Internal Auditing, risk assessment

**Competencies**

* Accountability
* Proactive
* High level execution and attention to detail
* Teamwork & Cooperation
* Ability to think, decide and act strategically in a pressurised environment.
* Continuous improvement and problem-solving ability.
* Great communicator at all levels with the ability to influence and coach effectively

If you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please apply!

The opportunity will be based in Middlesbrough on shift pattern.

**What We Would Like to Offer You**

The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package including staff discounts, competitive salary.

# Customer Success Manager I, UK & ireland

Leeds, UK

### **About us**

GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.  
  
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

### **The role**

Working with customers across the UK & Ireland,  you will be responsible for the successful adoption and growth of your portfolio across a variety of customers.

Your primary responsibility will be identifying a path to increase the breadth and depth of GoCardless usage and value across the customers footprint. You will need to work closely with your account team to map the scope by customer, identify stakeholders, assess risk/opportunity and create an execution plan.

As a part of our wider success team, you will also work closely with Professional Services to drive implementation and time to value, our Customer Advocacy team to enhance the customer experience and share success stories, and Renewal Managers to work towards retention alongside a dedicated Account Executive for expansion and growth opportunities.

You will own the customer lifecycle, delivering value at each milestone and will be excited to drive the awareness and uptake of GoCardless as an account to account payments provider offering Bank Debit alongside our Open Banking capabilities.

### **As a CSM at GoCardless you will:**

* Manage a book of business (BOB) and ensure delivery against milestones throughout the customer lifecycle, aligned with our team’s business KPIs.
* Demonstrate strategic ownership of your BOB by operating independently, proactively identifying solutions to challenges and blockers, and leveraging direction from CS leadership when required
* Drive commercial discussions with customers by devising strategies to drive positive Net Revenue Retention.
* Own and execute Account Plans tailored to each customer's strategic goals, positioning GoCardless as a trusted partner.
* Partner with the Account Management and Sales team on Account Planning and driving total book of business growth through competitive, market and whitespace analysis.
* Share commercial ownership of the Account Commercial Success including the need to Identify, nurture and close expansion opportunities across the base.
* Identify and build a strong relationship with key stakeholders including C-suite, champions and end-users.
* Work Cross functionally and collaboratively involving leadership across the business to drive customer value.
* Mitigate risk including managing renewals for existing customers
* Forecasting accountability for your owned book of business

### **What excites us:**

* 2+ years experience in complex end-to-end client facing work environment
* 2+ years experience with CS/Sales and/or Account Management
* Additional languages a plus
* Be a team player and have a growth mindset
* Strong listening and verbal communication skills: you will need to quickly understand customer needs or issues and deliver a clear and concise response via video calls, emails, in person meetings
* Ability to manage conflicting priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Be a good collaborator and can motivate or maintain enthusiasm of your team members
* Finance/Payments industry experience is a plus

**Base salary range:** £27,976 - £40,200

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point (£27,976 - £33,680) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

### **(some of) The good stuff**

* **Wellbeing** - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
* **Work away scheme** - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
* **Adaptive Working** - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
* **Parental leave** - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
* **Learning Budget** - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
* **Time off** - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)

### **Life at GoCardless**

We're an organisation defined by our values; We *start with why* before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We *act with integrity*, always. We *care deeply* about what we do and we know it's essential that we *be humble* whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

### **Diversity & Inclusion**

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. # The Core Engineering - Software Engineer - Analyst - Birmingham

Birmingham, West Midlands, England, United Kingdom

## Job Description

Market Risk Analytics & Reporting (A&R) is a group within Core Engineering in the Risk Division of Goldman Sachs. The group ensures the firm’s senior leadership, investors and regulators have a complete view of the positional, market, and client activity drivers of the firm’s market risk profile allowing them to take actionable and timely risk management decisions.

Risk Engineering is a multidisciplinary group of quantitative experts who are the authoritative producers of independent risk & capital metrics for the firm. Risk Engineering is responsible for modeling, producing, reviewing, interpreting, explaining and communicating risk & capital metrics and analytics used to ensure the firm adheres to its Risk Appetite and maintains the appropriate amount of Risk Capital. Risk Engineering provides risk & capital metrics, analytics and insights to the Chief Risk Officer, senior management, regulators, and other firm stakeholders.

**Role Responsibilities**

A&R delivers critical regulatory and risk metrics & analytics across risk domains (market, credit, liquidity, operational, capital) and firm activities via regular reporting, customized risk analysis, systematically generated risk reporting and risk tools​. This role will focus on Market Risk.

A&R has a unique vantage point in the firm’s risk data flows that, when coupled with a deep understanding of client and market activities, allows it to build scalable workflows, processes and procedures to deliver actionable risk insights​. The following are core responsibilities for A&R:

* Delivering regular and reliable risk metrics, analytics & insights based on deep understanding of the firm’s businesses and its client activities.
* Building robust, systematic & efficient workflows, processes and procedures around the production of risk analytics​ for financial & non-financial risk, risk capital and regulatory reporting.
* Attesting to the quality, timeliness and completeness of the underlying data used to produce these analytics​.

**Qualifications, Skills & Aptitude**

Eligible candidates are preferred to have the following:

* Masters or Bachelors degree in a quantitative discipline such as data science, mathematics, physics, econometrics, computer science or engineering.
* 1-3 years of experience, preferably in financial, regulatory or consulting environment
* Entrepreneurial, analytically creative, self-motivated and team-oriented.
* Excellent written, verbal and team-oriented communication skills.
* Working knowledge of the financial industry, markets and products and associated non-financial risk.
* Working knowledge of mathematics including statistics, time series analysis and numerical algorithms.
* Experience with programming in Python and SQL for extract transform load (ETL) operations and data analysis (including performance optimization). Experience in using languages such as R, Java, C++ is beneficial.
* Experience in developing data visualization and business intelligence solutions using tools such as, but not limited to, Tableau, Alteryx, PowerBI, and front-end technologies and languages.

# Founding ML Engineer — Live Music Intelligence

Gotobeat – The operating system for live music

Location: Remote-first (UTC to UTC+3 preferred) | Type: Full-time | Reports to: Head of Tech

Salary: Competitive + equity

How to apply: send your CV to alfredo@gotobeat.com

---

## The problem

Can this artist fill this room, in this city, on this Thursday? Every promoter bets their own money on that question, and most of them answer it with gut feel, a Spotify listener count and a phone call to a friend. A good answer puts the right act in a 300-cap room in Leeds two summers before it headlines a festival. A bad answer leaves a half-empty venue and a lost deposit.

We built a system that answers it better than gut feel. It is called Antonello. We are hiring the person who will own it.

## About Gotobeat

Gotobeat builds software for live music: for the artists who play, the venues that host and the promoters who book. We help emerging artists earn more, venues fill more seats and promoters spend less time on admin. The platform covers planning, promotion, ticketing and post-show settlement. It runs on an AWS serverless stack, Python data pipelines and LLM agents.

## Why this role matters

Most music data companies see one slice: streams, or social, or ticket sales. Gotobeat is a ticketing platform and a promoter tool, so we hold the dataset that ties them together: what an artist streamed, what they posted, where they played and how many people paid at the door. That join is the most valuable thing we own. Today one founder maintains it.

You are the first hire whose whole job is that data. You take over the models, the pipelines and the storage, and you own them end to end: from the notebook where a feature starts to the number a promoter reads before they sign a deal. When your forecast moves, shows get booked or not. The feedback is an empty room or a full one.

## What you take over on day one

* **Antonello, the capacity engine.** A per-city venue-capacity forecast: an XGBoost ensemble over an event-history prior, calibrated ranges, confidence gates that hold back a weak prediction, and an LLM evidence-repair loop that finds the shows our scrapers missed.
* **The discovery loop.** A daily pipeline that pulls new artists from Songstats, Spotify playlists and related-artist graphs, runs them through fit gates, genre families and liveness checks, and gives a promoter a shortlist that matches their taste and their rooms.
* **The data estate.** DynamoDB as the system of record, a change-data-capture mirror into a normalised Postgres schema on Supabase, S3 snapshots, and the API clients and data-partner integrations for streaming, social and touring data.
* **The analytics.** Sell-through and price suggestions, the hype and momentum scores, ad attribution across Meta and Google, and a rule engine that checks the model when the evidence is thin.

## What you'll do

* **35%** Build the best artist model in the music industry. Antonello forecasts what an act can draw in a city. Your job is to make that the number the industry trusts. Retrain it, recalibrate it and score it against what happened at the door. Decide when it should stay silent. Ship each improvement to production yourself.
* **25%** Own the data pipeline and the ingestion. Keep every source complete, fresh and cheap, and make the join between streaming, social, touring and ticket sales something a colleague can query in one line.
* **15%** Own the architecture of the data estate: the single-table design, the change-data-capture mirror into Postgres, and the schema every model and every query reads. Design the contracts so a new source or a new model plugs in without a migration weekend.
* **15%** Build the analytics a promoter bets on: expected sell-through, the right ticket price, which ad spend sold tickets, and the confidence behind each number.
* **10%** Expose the models as tools our LLM agents call, with the evaluation and the guardrails that let an agent draft a deal from a forecast.

## The stack

* Python 3.13 in Lambda containers for the models and the scrapers: XGBoost, numpy, Playwright.
* TypeScript on Node for the orchestration, the API and the promoter product: AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and SST v3 as infrastructure as code.
* DynamoDB with ElectroDB, DynamoDB Streams into Supabase Postgres, S3 for snapshots and artefacts.
* Claude, Gemini and Perplexity for the agents, called through MCP tool surfaces.
* No Kubernetes, no Spark cluster, no GPU farm. The data is small: tens of thousands of artists, hundreds of thousands of shows and the ticket sales behind them.
* No pager. The crons run overnight and the alarms land in Slack.

## You'll be successful here if you have

* Substantial experience of shipping machine learning that people relied on, including at least one model that was wrong in production and what you learned from it.
* Depth in tabular ML and forecasting: gradient boosting, calibration, evaluation on small and noisy data, and a preference for the simpler model that you can explain to a promoter.
* Data engineering: you have designed a schema, owned a pipeline end to end and made an expensive source cheap.
* Fluent Python, and enough TypeScript to ship the glue yourself.
* Practical LLM engineering: tool use, retrieval and evaluation, and a clear view of when a model must ask before it acts.
* Experience of building on your own: from a blank repo to something people use, with nobody else writing the tickets.
* A love of live music. You have stood in a half-empty room and known why.

### Nice to have

* Experience of music or entertainment data, for example at a streaming service, a data provider, a ticketing platform, a label or a booking agency.
* Experience with streaming, social or touring APIs, and with an ingestion that survives an upstream change.
* Experience with AWS serverless data patterns and change-data-capture pipelines.
* Experience with the MCP tool protocol and agent evaluation.

---

## How we work

* Remote-first, with quarterly in-person hack weeks in London.
* A small, senior team with no management layers and a lot of autonomy.
* One-week sprints, async communication and fast decisions.
* The founder who built the current models works with you for the first months, then hands over.
* We value clean code, continuous learning and doing right by artists.

## Benefits

* Competitive salary, set by experience, plus founding-team equity.
* Fully remote, with the hours that suit you.
* We engage you as an employee or as a contractor, according to the country where you live.
* Unlimited paid holiday, plus local public holidays.
* Free gig tickets and backstage passes to all Gotobeat shows.
* A budget for the hardware, the data and the conferences you need.

---

## Hiring process

1. Intro chat (30 min): the role, the music and whether we make sense to each other.
2. Technical deep dive (90 min): you walk us through a model you shipped, then we pair on a prediction from our data that went wrong. No LeetCode, no take-home.
3. Founders' chat (30 min): vision, values, equity and any remaining questions.

Total time from first call to offer: about two weeks.

Solihull, England, United Kingdom

**THE ROLE.**

At Gymshark, we’re not just creating products, we’re shaping the future of performance and lifestyle wear. As we continue to grow globally, we’re looking for a **Product Developer – Accessories** to help bring high‐quality, technically sound, and innovative products to life.

This role sits at the heart of our product creation process, owning the end‐to‐end development of accessories and ensuring they meet Gymshark’s standards for quality, performance, sustainability, and compliance.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING.**

As Product Developer, you’ll lead and manage the accessories product development process from concept through to final sign‐off, ensuring products are delivered **on time, to spec, and to the highest standards**.

Key responsibilities include:

* Owning and managing the **product development critical path**, ensuring all milestones and deadlines are met and proactively addressing any risks or delays.
* Leading the **technical development** of accessories, including construction, fit, and overall product make‐up.
* Collaborating closely with **Design, Fit, Colour, Raw Materials, Quality, and Sourcing** teams to ensure seamless cross‐functional alignment.
* Acting as the **technical point of contact** for all assigned products, resolving issues efficiently and maintaining clear communication across teams.
* Ensuring all products meet **Gymshark quality standards**, safety requirements, and legal and regulatory compliance.
* Verifying that products align with **performance and sustainability claims**.
* Partnering with **vendors and suppliers** to ensure technical specifications, timelines, and quality standards are achieved.
* Managing and maintaining accurate **technical documentation**, including tech packs, samples, testing results, and development records.
* Providing regular, clear updates on development progress, risks, and key decisions to your manager and stakeholders.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR.**

#### Essential Skills & Experience

* Strong technical knowledge of **accessories construction, fit, and product development**.
* Solid understanding of **accessories regulations, safety requirements, and testing standards**.
* Proven experience managing **product development timelines and critical paths**.
* Good technical awareness of related development processes, including **colour development, raw materials, and quality**.
* Familiarity with **sustainability practices**, compliance standards, and performance claims.
* Experience working cross‐functionally with **Design, Sourcing, Production, and Quality** teams.
* Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions‐focused mindset.
* Ability to provide **clear, accurate status reporting**.
* Proficiency in **PLM systems, Excel**, and other relevant product.
* Strong analytical and critical‐thinking skills.

You’ll be joining a fast‐paced, ambitious, and collaborative environment where your work directly impacts the products worn by our global community. We move quickly, challenge convention, and expect high standards — but we also support each other every step of the way.

This is a hybrid role and would require the successful candidate to be on-site at least **4 days a week** at our HQ in Solihull.

Healx is looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to build LLM-agentic workflows that power our drug discovery platform.

Reporting to our Director of Tech Strategy, you'll design and build agents that solve real drug discovery problems. Working closely with scientists across the company, you'll understand the questions that matter most to their work, then design and refine agents that reason over our knowledge graph, proprietary methods, scientific literature and other sources to generate, triage and rationalise testable therapeutic hypotheses for rare diseases.

You won't be starting from scratch. We've adopted an agentic framework (our stack currently includes Python, ADK and AgentSpace) and built workflows already delivering impact across our drug discovery platform. But this is a fast-moving field, so a big part of the role is helping us adapt as the landscape shifts. You'll work alongside the technical lead who owns our agentic infrastructure, with scope to take ownership of specific workflows and grow your influence as you do.

You'll join a cross-functional team of machine learning engineers, software engineers, bioinformaticians, drug discovery scientists and clinicians, all working to  sharpen how Healx  makes better decisions in drug discovery.

* Build and refine AI-agentic workflows on our internal framework to help drug discovery scientists generate the best testable therapeutic hypotheses to progress.
* Translate discovery problems into agent designs, working out where an agentic approach genuinely adds value, and where it doesn’t
* Integrate agents with our knowledge graph, proprietary methods, scientific literature and other sources so they reason over the right evidence for each problem
* Expand and maintain our existing GenAI tools so they keep pace with the team’s needs and a fast-moving ecosystem
* Contribute to how we evaluate agentic workflows, helping shape sensible evals, testing and quality standards as the practice matures
* Write clear, maintainable, well-documented code that others on the team can build on

In 3 months, you have:

* Got to grips with our agentic framework and the discovery problems it serves, and made your first contributions land in the codebase
* Built working relationships with the scientists and engineers you partner with, and started turning their feedback into concrete improvements

In 6 months you have:

+ Taken at least one agentic workflow from idea to a production tool scientists use in our drug discovery pipeline — built on our framework, with sensible evaluation and documentation
+ Operating with real independence — owning agentic workflows end to end, proposing improvements.

* You've built and shipped LLM-agentic systems that deliver real value — agents that use tools, orchestrate multi-step workflows and behave reliably in production.
* You have at least 2 years of software engineer or ML engineer working experience. And you have strong software engineering fundamentals — you write clear, tested, maintainable Python code that others can build on
* Fluency with the modern LLM/agent toolkit — model APIs, prompting, tool use, RAG, and the patterns this fast-moving ecosystem is converging on (MCP, agent frameworks, evals).
* You enjoy working closely with non-engineers — you are the kind of person who'll sit with a scientist to understand what they actually need.

It’s a bonus if you have:

+ Experience in drug discovery, biology, or another life science domain
+ Familiarity with knowledge graphs or reasoning over structured or heterogeneous data
+ Experience building evaluation harnesses or testing strategies for LLM systems
+ A track record of picking up unfamiliar domains quickly and becoming useful fast
